jobs.title: Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250
jobs.description:
Fellowships Program Coordinator (5156C), Graduate Division Ops #89250 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Graduate Funding Unit plays a central role in maintaining the highest level of academic excellence possible at UC Berkeley. We provide fellowships, funding, and program support to attract the most competitive students to our university and provide funding opportunities for students at various stages of their academic career. Our programs exist to give students opportunities to devote themselves fully to the pursuit of their scholarly and professional interests. Our knowledge and expertise in all areas of graduate funding and student life provide a strong foundation for advising the students, faculty, and staff across our vast and diverse campus.
  
  
The Student Funding team trains and advises staff and faculty departmental advisors in over 125 degree programs, offers direct advising to approximately 13,000 graduate and professional students, as well as individuals seeking admission into a graduate program at Berkeley. Training and expertise includes fellowship and academic support funding and collective bargaining agreement administration for academic student employees and graduate student researchers.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Fellowships Program Coordinator plays a significant role in supporting graduate students through the administration of Graduate Division, Campus, National, and International fellowship programs on behalf of the campus. This position works with internal and external organizations to coordinate graduate student fellowships, providing support to students, faculty, and staff from application to evaluation to awarding. The Fellowships Program Coordinator serves as an expert resource to update formulas and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies, ensuring proper payment of awards and monitoring compliance with fellowship terms. Additionally, this position administers and tracks the current University Fellowship allocation system, analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery, and partners with departmental staff to provide accurate and transparent information about funding to help students achieve their academic goals.
  
  
Application Review Date
  
  
The First Review Date for this job is October 19, 2026. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Fellowship Program Administration - 30%
  
  
Implements and coordinates graduate student fellowship programs administered by the Graduate Division.
  
Works with internal and external organizations to coordinate procedures.
  
Serves as expert resource to update applications and eligibility requirements according to national and constituent regulations and policies.
  
Analyzes data to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery.
  
  
NSF GRFP Administration - 30%
  
  
Serves as campus-wide expert and steward of National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship Program (NSF GRFP).
  
Acts as student facing Coordinating Official, working with fellows, faculty, and staff to provide information, respond to inquiries about program policies, and interface with the NSF.
  
Interprets regulations and develops or recommends procedures to ensure compliance and accurate aid delivery.
  
Reconciles large volumes of student data from multiple sources and adjusts Grants Roster Report. Coordinates yearly NSF GRFP info session.
  
Updates NSF GRFP Administration at UCB guide.
  
Works with fellows, GSAOs, and Berkeley Regional Services to ensure correct assessment and funding source.
  
  
Travel Grant Administration - 10%
  
  
Reviews Slate fellowship application data to administer the Graduate Division's Conference Travel Grant program.
  
Monitors, tracks, and makes awards in Campus Solutions.
  
Tracks budget and provides analysis of usage and suggestions on how to improve the process.
  
Provides individual counseling on non-routine, sensitive aid issues.
  
Exercises professional judgment to authorize changes in financial aid awards.
  
  
Fellowship and Block Grant Allocations - 10%
  
  
Provides annual Berkeley and Chancellor's Fellowship allocation information to divisional leadership and tracks their departmental allocations.
  
Monitors and tracks Chancellor's carry forward and other exceptions.
  
Delivers annual Block Grant memos to programs.
  
Memos provide yearly allocation amounts as well as Graduate Opportunity Program, Mentored Research Award, and UC Dissertation Year nomination amounts.
  
Recommends new or changes to policy in areas needing clarification, and supports the Director of Student Funding to identify solutions to existing fellowship program policies without precedent.

jobs.title: Farm School Teacher and Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Ray of Sunshine Farm is looking for an energetic, organized and entrepreneurial Farm School Teacher & Program Coordinator to take ownership of our children's farm education program.

This is more than a teaching position. We're looking for someone who loves kids, loves nature and animals and can run the program from end to end, from helping get the word out, managing registration and communication with families, teaching our prepared curriculum or developing your own, and then delivering a wonderfuland memorable hands-on experience at the farm.

Our parent/guardian accompanied farm classes introduce young children to animals, gardening, food and agriculture through real experiences: feeding animals, collecting eggs, planting seeds, harvesting vegetables, exploring the garden, and learning about life on a working farm.

The role:

Teaching & program delivery

* Lead engaging, age-appropriate classes for young children
* Teach through hands-on experiences with our animals, gardens and crops
* Follow and improve existing lesson plans and develop new activities over time
* Lead songs, crafts and farm activities
* Confidently manage groups of children while maintaining appropriate safety rules
* Create a warm, welcoming experience for children and their parents/caregivers
* Prepare materials before class and reset/clean up afterward

Program management & administration

* Own the class calendar and coordinate upcoming sessions
* Set up and maintain classes and registration on our website
* Monitor enrollment and manage class rosters
* Communicate with registered families before and after classes
* Answer routine questions from prospective families
* Manage cancellations, transfers, waitlists and other registration details
* Track enrollment and identify classes that need additional promotion
* Maintain supplies and anticipate what will be needed for upcoming classes

Marketing & enrollment

* Help keep classes full by actively promoting upcoming programs
* Create and post class announcements on appropriate local and social media channels
* Help with email/newsletter and social-media promotion
* Reach out to local parent groups, preschools, schools and community organizations
* Develop relationships that can generate repeat enrollment and referrals
* Look for new opportunities to grow the program, including new class ideas, age groups, special events and seasonal programs

Who we're looking for:

This position would be a great fit for someone who combines a natural ability with children with strong organization and initiative.

You don't need to arrive knowing everything about farming. We can teach you about our animals, gardens and farm routines. It's much harder to teach someone how to engage a group of young children, communicate well with parents, stay on top of administrative details and take genuine ownership of a program.

Experience in preschool or elementary education, outdoor education, children's programming, camps, recreation programs, nature education, program coordination or a similar field would be valuable.

We're especially interested in someone who:

* Loves working with young children
* Is warm and engaging while still comfortable being in charge
* Is extremely reliable and organized
* Communicates professionally with parents
* Is comfortable using websites, email, social media and online registration tools
* Doesn't need to be told every small thing that needs to happen
* Enjoys building something and thinking about how to make it better
* Is comfortable outdoors, around animals and getting dirty

What success looks like:

A successful person in this role isn't just someone who teaches a great class. The whole program runs well because they own it and they are looking to grow with the farm!

Families know what's happening. Registration is accurate. Classes are promoted early enough to fill. Materials are ready. Parents get their questions answered. Classes start on time. Children have a great experience. And after each session, you're already thinking about how to make the next one even better.

About Ray of Sunshine Farm

Ray of Sunshine Farm is a small working farm in San Jose's Almaden Valley. We grow fruits and vegetables, raise a variety of farm animals, and create opportunities for families and children to experience agriculture firsthand.

Our farm school isn't intended to recreate a classroom outdoors. We want children to touch, explore, participate, ask questions and develop a real connection with each other, the animals, plants, food and the natural world.

**Schedule:** Part-time and flexible; combination of scheduled classes and flexible administrative hours

Pay: $28.00 - $40.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10.0 – 30.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Digital Delivery Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
##### **Who We Are**

VEC is a leading construction technology services provider that is at the forefront of innovation in the construction industry, delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that revolutionize the way construction projects are designed and built. Our Mission is to challenge the status quo and reshape the way we plan, design, and construct the built world so Humanity can thrive sustainably. We partner with contractors, engineers, and developers/owners across the US and deploy our team of construction and technology professionals to improve project delivery. We support large projects across many sectors of the industry: Data Centers, Healthcare, Life Sciences, Tech, Education, Transportation, Aviation, Commercial Office Space, and Public Works. We love what we do, our VECommunity, and helping the best build better.

##### **Overview**

The Digital Delivery Project Coordinator (DDPC) supports digital delivery execution on a single data center project, administering the Digital Delivery program across cross-platform data so that project-level tracking, meeting records, action logs, reporting inputs, and information flow stay current across every digital delivery workstream. The role reports to the Digital Delivery Program Manager on a single-site assignment.

The DDPC is the central driver for project data flow and performance visibility in a multi-prime infrastructure environment. The role maps cross-platform data sources, administers Delivery Control System (DCS) inputs, and translates spatial, financial, and logistical updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards. The DDPC manages the single source of truth across the full project lifecycle, works from a philosophy of evidence-driven decision making, and can build and deploy custom automated tools to measure digital asset readiness from design through operational handover. By acting as the clearing house for information flow and preventing data fragmentation, the DDPC protects the critical path of the build and frees the Program Manager to focus on campus scope, program-level risk, and client strategy.

This is a project-level coordination role rather than a technical BIM or VDC lead role. The DDPC supports program scope but does not set it, and does not own overall digital delivery strategy, multi-campus program governance, final CDE governance standards, VDC coordination execution or model quality approval, OFE procurement decisions, commissioning strategy, final handover requirements, or executive client messaging. You do not need to be a BIM expert, model author, engineer, scheduler, cost manager, or commissioning lead. You do need to understand enough to recognize missing information, overdue actions, unclear ownership, and issues that require escalation.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Delivery Administration**

* Track required documents, models, and data uploads across the project.
* Monitor late, missing, duplicate, or outdated information and chase it down before it becomes a blocker.
* Maintain meeting agendas and issue accurate minutes on time.

**Coordination, Meetings & Action Item Management**

* Maintain action item logs and keep overdue items clearly identified.
* Produce project status summaries for the Program Manager and project team.
* Administer issue and risk logs so blockers surface early.
* Track deliverable status and make sure stakeholders understand what actions they own.

**CDE, Document & Deliverable Tracking**

* Support naming, metadata, and folder-structure compliance checks in the common data environment.
* Support version-status reporting for models and key deliverables.
* Flag CDE compliance issues to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Review, phase out, and audit inactive users in the CDE environment.
* Keep CDE and deliverable trackers current and reduce data fragmentation across platforms.

**Reporting & Dashboard Input Support**

* Gather weekly updates from digital delivery workstream leads ahead of reporting deadlines.
* Flag missing, stale, or conflicting data before it reaches a report.
* Support weekly and monthly reporting packages, including dashboard updates.
* Administer Delivery Control System inputs and translate project updates into executive-facing KPI dashboards.

**Software & Technical Proficiency**

Proficiency needed in the following tools:

* Autodesk suite, including Forma, Navisworks, and Revit, at a level sufficient to navigate models and deliverables.
* Common data environment platforms, with the ability to run validation checksets and work to the program SOP.
* Excel, Smartsheet, or similar for trackers, logs, and spreadsheets.
* Power BI or comparable dashboard tools for reporting inputs and KPI visualization.
* AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to speed up routine work, with output checked before it goes anywhere.

##### **Who You Are**

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in construction project delivery, project coordination, document control, or digital delivery support.
* Working knowledge of construction project delivery, BIM/VDC basics, CDE and document control workflows, RFIs, submittals, issue logs, project dashboards, meeting routines, OFE and vendor tracking, and closeout or handover tracking.
* Ability to build and maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, trackers, and issue logs at scale.
* Clear written communication, particularly in meeting minutes, status summaries, and escalations.
* Ability to track action items and deadlines across many parties without letting items go quiet.

* Experience on data center or other mission-critical technical construction projects.
* Experience in a multi-prime or multi-stakeholder project environment.
* Hands-on experience administering a common data environment, including compliance checks and user auditing.

jobs.description:
**POSITION:**

The Finance & Operations Manager oversees the day-­to-­day financial and administrative operations of Cancer Support Community SF Bay Area. This position is responsible for managing all accounting and banking functions for the organization, and works closely with the Chief Executive Officer to generate and track budgets both for internal purposes and outside funders (in conjunction with the Director of Development). In addition, the Finance & Operations Manager performs administrative duties, human resource coordination, assists with grants preparation, facility oversight and coordination and other duties as assigned.

This is an exempt position that reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*Finance*

* Manage the overall accounting and bookkeeping for the organization including accounts payable and receivable, capital assets, banking, and payroll functions
* Work closely with the CEO and Director of Development to handle revenue for all development initiatives, including but not limited to:
* Creating and monitoring all grant budgets and grant-­‐related financial information
* Processing and tracking all forms of donations; tracking use of restricted funds; producing revenue reports
* Interface with CPA firm to coordinate annual financial audits and oversee all 990 reports
* Facilitate the annual budget process
* Provide monthly financial reporting and analysis of financial statements, including statement of activities, fund balance, and sources/uses of funds, to the CEO and, as requested, to the Board of Directors

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

I am Sarah Wagner Rayburn, co-founder of Marin Home Team at Compass. We have been serving Marin County clients for over twenty-five years and have built a reputation on deep local knowledge, strong relationships, and attention to detail.

I am looking for a Business Operations Manager to work directly with me.

This is a hands-on role for someone organized, proactive and tech-comfortable who genuinely enjoys making things run well. You will be the person who keeps the wheels turning so I can focus on what I do best, which is serving clients.

It is not a sit-behind-a-desk-all-day job. Some days you are in the field, checking on listings, making keys, meeting vendors. Other days you are at your computer, managing paperwork, updating systems, building marketing materials. You need to be based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley every day.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**TRANSACTION SUPPORT, WHICH IS THE CORE OF THE ROLE**

You will manage the operational backbone of every deal, from listing or buyer prep through to closing.

LISTINGS. Work with our transaction coordinator to prepare disclosure packages. Coordinate inspections and vendor work. Manage timelines. Handle MLS prep and entry. Develop marketing materials. Coordinate photography and photo selection. Keep everything organized in Compass and our team systems.

BUYERS. Set up new buyer files in Notejoy and Compass Business Tracker. Set up Compass Collections and Top Agent Network searches. Prepare paperwork. Track escrow timelines.

CONTRACTS AND PAPERWORK. Prep offers and other transactional documents. Manage DocuSign and Compass e-sign workflows. Review documents for accuracy. Handle contingency removals and timeline deadlines. Execute referral agreements.

ESCROW. Track deadlines across all active transactions. Anticipate upcoming needs. Coordinate with lenders, title companies and clients.

**LISTING MARKETING**

PROPERTY MARKETING. Write property descriptions and marketing copy, working with me and with AI. Create flyers and brochures using Compass tools. Build and send marketing emails. Update our team website and individual listing sites.

BRAND CONSISTENCY. Keep MarinHome.Team current and cohesive. Maintain Compass collateral and marketing materials. Make sure our brand looks polished at every touchpoint.

**DAILY OPERATIONS**

THE INBOX. Monitor and manage email related to my transactions, plus Slack and text. Field questions and requests. Route things to the right person.

THE CALENDAR. Maintain and update the calendar. Coordinate showing schedules. Schedule vendor appointments. Track inspection and timeline deadlines.

CRM AND DATABASE. Manage Compass Contact Management. Track client relationships, update contact records, manage my buyer and seller pipelines, track sales data for reporting.

INFORMATION MANAGEMENT. Maintain our Notejoy workspace: buyer profiles, vendor lists, listing details, templates, passwords. Create and update shared documents. Keep everything organized and findable.

**TECH AND AI**

Explore parts of the Compass platform we are not using, or could be using better, and bring back what would actually help. Work with me on building AI tools that make the business run more efficiently.

This is a real part of the job, not a nice-to-have. We use AI daily for writing, organizing and streamlining, and I am actively building more of it.

**IN THE FIELD**

BOOTS ON THE GROUND. Check on listings for lights, lockboxes and signage. Meet vendors and inspectors on site. Pick up and make keys. Coordinate staging logistics. Handle broker tour catering and setup.

CLIENT-FACING MOMENTS. You may deal with clients by phone or in person. You will need to be warm, professional and comfortable representing the Marin Home Team.

VENDORS. Schedule inspectors, stagers, photographers and contractors. Manage quotes and project timelines. Maintain our vendor list.

**ADMIN**

EXPENSES. Add my expenses to the team tracker, pay invoices, keep the records straight.

SUBSCRIPTIONS AND TOOLS. Manage operational subscriptions such as the website, Dropbox and Zoom. Troubleshoot tech issues. Research new tools.

INDUSTRY. Attend Compass meetings and industry events as needed, take notes, keep me informed.

REPORTING. Enter new listings and buyer activity in our business tracker. Monitor Top Agent. Network for inventory and opportunities.

**THE FIRST SIX WEEKS**

My days are genuinely different from one another, and real estate does not run to a tidy schedule. So rather than pretend I know exactly which hours I will need you and get it wrong, the first six weeks are a working trial for both of us.

Part of your job in those six weeks is helping me work out what the rhythm actually is. Which days, which hours, what gets batched, what has to happen live. At the end of it we lock in a schedule that reflects reality, and you will know what you are agreeing to because you helped build it.

If it is not right for either of us at that point, we shake hands and part on good terms.

**WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR:**

THE ESSENTIALS

* You are organized in a way other people notice and appreciate
* You are a problem solver who anticipates what is needed before being asked
* You are comfortable with technology and pick up new tools quickly
* You communicate clearly, professionally and warmly
* You can work independently and manage your own time
* You are based in Southern Marin, or happy to drive to Mill Valley daily. This role needs you physically present here on a regular basis
* You have strong computer skills: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Claude, and a willingness to learn whatever else comes

NICE TO HAVE

* Previous experience in real estate operations, or somewhere similarly client-facing and
* detail-heavy
* Comfort with CRM systems. Compass experience is a bonus and not a requirement
* Marketing or design skills
* Social media experience
* Experience with DocuSign, Dropbox, Slack or other project manageme

jobs.description:
**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**  

**Operations Manager**
----------------------

**Fremont, California**

CertainTeed Roofing Products Group is seeking an Operations Manager to lead production, maintenance, facilities, and repair activities at its unionized Fremont manufacturing facility. This senior site leadership role is responsible for delivering safe, reliable, efficient, and profitable operations while meeting customer commitments and achieving safety, quality, delivery, cost, and service objectives.

The Operations Manager will establish operating priorities, strengthen equipment reliability, manage staffing and capacity, control departmental budgets, and advance continuous-improvement initiatives. This position develops front-line leaders, supports positive labor relations, and partners closely with the Plant Manager and cross-functional teams to align daily execution with the plant’s operating plan, capital priorities, and long-term strategy.

### **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Lead production, maintenance, facilities, and repair activities to achieve plant objectives, the annual profit plan, monthly forecasts, and customer requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with environmental, health, safety, quality, and operating policies and procedures.
* Improve operational efficiency across production lines, maintenance, and facilities through the effective use of people, equipment, materials, and available capacity.
* Monitor safety, quality, production schedules, equipment reliability, operating costs, staffing, and customer delivery performance; communicate risks, progress, and opportunities to the Plant Manager.
* Evaluate production-load changes and adjust labor, equipment, schedules, and other resources to meet changing business requirements.
* Review and strengthen operating practices to improve product quality, equipment performance, labor productivity, housekeeping, 5S, cost control, and on-time shipment performance.
* Lead, coach, and develop manufacturing leaders and supervisors while supporting consistent accountability, employee engagement, morale, discipline, and positive labor relations.
* Partner with engineering, quality, safety, logistics, finance, purchasing, human resources, and regional support teams on operational issues, staffing, inventory, maintenance, and capital priorities.
* Champion World Class Manufacturing, Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, standardized work, statistical process control, and other continuous-improvement methods.
* Perform other duties as assigned and provide flexible support for a continuous operation, including occasional off-shift, weekend, shutdown, or emergency coverage.

  
**IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

**Position Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in **Mechanical or Industrial Engineering is required**. A master’s degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Operations, or a related field is preferred.
* **Experience:** **6–8 years of manufacturing experience in a management capacity is required**, with demonstrated experience leading manufacturing operations and people.
* Three or more years of people-leadership experience in a **unionized, continuous-process, or heavy manufacturing environment** is preferred, with exposure to safety, reliability, cost, quality, labor relations, and continuous improvement.
* Strong working knowledge of manufacturing processes, product structures, quality standards, and modern manufacturing technologies and techniques is required.
* Working knowledge of **TPM, autonomous and professional maintenance, early equipment management, Statistical Process Control (SPC), 5S, standardized work, Lean principles, and Six Sigma methodologies** is required.
* Demonstrated human-relations and leadership skills, including the ability to effectively engage the skills and talents of employees to improve business performance, are required.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and proficiency with **Microsoft Office Suite** are required.
* Lean, Six Sigma, World Class Manufacturing (WCM), or an equivalent continuous-improvement certification is preferred and may be held at hire or obtained through a company development plan.
* Ability to provide schedule flexibility in support of a continuous manufacturing operation, including occasional **off-shift, weekend, shutdown, and emergency coverage**. The position may require up to **10% business travel** for regional meetings, training, supplier or sister-plant visits, and other business needs.
* **Physical and Work Environment Requirements:** The role requires working within an active manufacturing environment and includes standing and walking for sustained periods, sitting, climbing/balancing, bending, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and use of hands and fingers. The position may involve exposure to heat, cold, wet or humid conditions, dust, fumes, chemicals, moving equipment, noise, hazardous materials, and vibration. Required personal protective equipment and safety clothing must be worn in designated plant areas.

  
**A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US**

Through the responsible development of innovative and sustainable building products, CertainTeed, headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania, has helped shape the building products industry for more than 110 years. Founded in 1904 as General Roofing Manufacturing Company, the firm's slogan "Quality Made Certain, Satisfaction Guaranteed," inspired the name CertainTeed. Today, CertainTeed is a leading North American brand of exterior and interior building products, including roofing, siding, trim, insulation, drywall and ceilings.

A subsidiary of Saint-Gobain, one of the world’s largest and oldest building products companies, CertainTeed has more than 6,300 employees and more than 60 manufacturing facilities throughout the United States and Canada. www.certainteed.com

jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 10/29/2026
  
Meet the Team
  
  
Product Operations Central (Process and Business Intelligence) is a core component of the Product Operations team, providing a centralized hub of multi-disciplinary expertise that fortifies the strategic and operational framework for Business Units (BUs) across Cisco’s product portfolio. This team acts as a strategic partner, collaborating with cross-functional leaders to define Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) strategies, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation across NPI, sustaining, and end-to-end supply chain processes.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
In this role, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our future by proactively collaborating with peers, senior leaders, and functional SMEs. You will bridge the gap between complex PLM business processes and advanced data-driven insights. By implementing innovative analytical solutions, you will ensure our operational framework is both scalable and highly effective.
  
  
As part of this role, you will drive the strategic vision for Business Intelligence (BI) by leading the strategy and execution of initiatives that improve process improvement and foster data-driven decision-making across the product portfolio. You will lead and influence cross-functional collaboration by orchestrating efforts among Product Operations, Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO), Technology& Quality (T), and Engineering teams, unifying these groups under shared data objectives. Your expertise in sophisticated analytics and data integrity will be critical as you define and automate quality frameworks to ensure high-fidelity data, performing deep-dive analyses into product health, development velocity, and operational KPIs.
  
Leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP) tools such as BigQuery and Cloud Composer, you will enable scalable data processing and utilize Google Workspace for collaborative policy management and cross-functional project tracking. You will also play a key role in risk management and mitigation by navigating operational risks through collaborative engagement and developing data-backed mitigation strategies integrated into our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) business processes.
  
  
Operational optimization is another core responsibility, where you will use design-thinking sessions within our business sensing framework to understand business unit challenges and ensure analytical solutions are perfectly aligned with business goals.
  
  
This role drives significant business impact by aligning the organization toward a unified, data-driven PLM strategy that accelerates velocity across New Product Introduction (NPI) and sustaining phases. It harnesses scalable intelligence through GCP infrastructure to transform large datasets into real-time operational insights, improves operational efficiency by automating data quality and BI solutions to reduce manual processes, and supports risk mitigation by equipping leadership with analytical tools to identify and address supply chain and product lifecycle risks proactively.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Information Systems, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in PLM, NPI/Sustaining, HW development, and end-to-end supply chain engineering.
* 5 + years of program management experience leading cross functional teams in complex environments with layered dependencies.
* Expert proficiency in SQL, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Proven experience with Google Cloud platform or similar for data visualization.

Preferred skills
  
  

* Experience in Python or R for advanced statistical analysis.
* Familiarity with Data Governance/Quality tools (e.g., Alation, Big Eye, Monte Carlo).
* Ability to articulate complex data-driven strategies and gain consensus at the executive level.
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications and automation to enhance supply chain/product development.
* Strong commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About this Opportunity:**  
At Regency Centers, our people are our greatest asset, and we believe that our highly skilled and talented team makes us better. We are seeking a full-time Project Manager (Construction) to join our regional office located in Walnut Creek, California. The Project Manager leads construction across an assigned portfolio of existing shopping centers, with a primary focus on tenant improvements, landlord work, redevelopment, space reconfigurations, and property capital improvements. They manage budgets, schedules, consultants, and contractors from scope development and design through permitting, construction, tenant turnover, and closeout. This position works closely with Leasing, Property Management, Tenant Coordination, and Development Accounting to meet lease obligations and operating needs while coordinating work around existing tenants and customers. The Project Manager handles multiple concurrent projects and may support major ground-up developments as assigned.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**  

* Manage construction at existing shopping centers, including landlord work, tenant improvements, white box work, vacant space preparation, space divisions, redevelopment, and facade renovations. Ensure delivery is on time, on budget, and consistent with lease, design, and brand standards.
* Assist with ground up development projects.
* Collaborate with Leasing, Tenant Coordination, Property Management, and Legal to define landlord delivery obligations, evaluate scopes of work, and align lease language and construction exhibits. Coordinate landlord work with tenant delivery requirements.
* Lead budgeting and scheduling for tenant, redevelopment, and property construction projects, including estimates for landlord lease obligations and capital improvements. Monitor and forecast costs, address risks, and track deviations from plan.
* Oversee the preparation and execution of construction contracts and change orders in partnership with Contract Administration. Ensure contractor performance, insurance compliance, and lien waiver documentation.
* Manage existing condition assessments, design, permitting, and utility coordination for tenant work, redevelopment, and property improvements. Evaluate constructability, support entitlement approvals when needed, and plan construction phasing to limit disruption to tenants and customers.
* Manage assigned property capital improvements in coordination with Property Management, including roof replacements, parking lot reconstruction, facade work, HVAC replacements, and major site or building system upgrades.
* Track project milestones, landlord completion dates, and closeout requirements. Maintain project reporting tools and internal dashboards, and provide regular updates to construction leadership, Property Management, Tenant Coordination, and Accounting.

Are You Qualified?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field
* Minimum five (5) years of retail or commercial construction management experience, to include supervisory experience
* Ability to travel regionally & frequently visit all assigned construction sites
* Ability to work varying and flexible hours as needed for tenant delivery, construction in operating shopping centers, and public meetings
* Experience with tenant improvements, redevelopment, and construction in operating shopping centers preferred
* Knowledge of retail construction, tenant improvements, redevelopment, existing building systems, and permitting
* Skilled in reviewing documents for conformity to standards of Regency jurisdictions and/or tenants
* Ability to comprehend architectural and engineering drawings and complex legal documents
* Proficiency with personal computers and MS Office, MS Excel, MS Project, Zoom, & JD Edwards software
* Skilled in analyzing construction costs for landlord lease obligations, tenant improvements, redevelopment, and property capital projects and recommending budgetary adjustments as appropriate
* Regency Centers will not sponsor employment-based immigration petitions or applications for this position, including but not limited to H-1B, TN visa, or permanent residency.

**Personal Traits We Value:**  

* Project management skills (planning, organizing, informing, directing others)
* Decisiveness, problem-solving, time-management, multi-tasking and presentation skills
* Communication skills (interpersonal savvy, customer focus, oral and written communication)
* Trust and integrity
* Negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Ability to work within a team environment

**A Little Bit About Us:**  
We own and operate premier shopping centers in suburban neighborhoods in the top cities and markets across the country. We live by a strong set of values, which have guided us for more than 60 years.
  
  
Our centers thrive with highly productive grocers, restaurants, service providers, and terrific retailers that connect to their communities and customers. We are also active developers of new shopping centers that feature great merchandising, placemaking, and customer engagement as part of our Fresh Look™ program.
  
  
We are a vertically integrated real estate company and a qualified real estate investment trust (REIT) that is self-administered, self-managed, and an S&P 500 Index member. Learn more about us at RegencyCenters.com.
  
  
**Benefits:**  
Our compensation and benefits package is very competitive and includes the following benefits and more. For additional information visit www.regencycenters.com/careers.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  

* 23+ PTO days annually
* 11 paid holidays (in addition to PTO)
* Paid leave programs (parental, compassion, bereavement, jury duty, and military)
* Health Advocacy + Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Financial Security
  

* 401(k) with a generous company match plus corporate profit sharing
* Anniversary stock grant awards
* Health Savings Account

jobs.description:
As a Consor teammate, you’ll join a collaborative network of water and transportation experts dedicated to supporting clients through the entire project lifecycle. You’ll have access to the resources of a large consulting firm while experiencing the community feel of a local team. Grow your career by working on impactful projects that shape inspiring communities—and expand your potential along the way.

* Regular Full-Time
* Onsite

  

***What Your Day Will Look Like:***

  
  
  

As a transportation engineering project manager, you’ll lead the delivery of roadway improvement projects from conceptual design through preliminary, intermediate, and final design phases to construction. You`ll manage all aspects of schematic or PS&E plan preparation for roadway projects. The transportation engineering project manager reports to the area manager.

Yearly Salary Range: $180,000 to $260,000 +

  
  

***What You'll Do:***

  
  

• Prepare scope, schedule, and budgets for projects and task orders.

• Oversee the design for roadway, highway, and traffic engineering projects.

• Assist in business development and proposal efforts.

• Achieve in project pursuits to win work, coordinating with client account management leads.

  

***What You'll Need:***

  
  

• Bachelor of Science in Civil or Structural Engineering.

• Minimum eight years of transportation engineering experience.

• Professional Engineer (PE) license.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD and Civil3D software.

•This hybrid job operates between an office environment and a field environment and routinely requires the use of standard office equipment such as computers, phones and copy machines. May require occasional exposure to work environments that may include inclement weather, heat, humidity, noise, hazard, atmospheric conditions, and bodies of water, depending on project requirements.

•While performing the duties of this job, physical demands of the employee include frequent sitting, moving, standing, talking, hearing, and occasional balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, handling, grasping, and feeling. This job may occasionally require operating a company vehicle, and lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling up to 35 lbs.

* Professional Engineer (PE) license.

  

***Get to Know Us:***

  
  

***What Benefits*** ***You’ll*** ***Enjoy:***

**We invest in us. Because our team members go above, below, and beyond the surface to care for our communities (inside and out), we do our best to take care of you by providing a** **comprehensive benefits package** (opens in new window)**!**Eligibility for some of the benefits outlined below is based on full-time work status; part-time and contingent positions are only eligible based on hours worked. If you have questions, contact careers@consoreng.com (opens in new window).

* **Work-Life Alignment –** Industry-competitive PTO, seven paid holidays and two floating holidays, flexible work schedules, paid parental leave, and eligibility for hybrid and remote work options for some employees based on role responsibilities.

* **Wellness –** Medical, dental and vision insurance, employee assistance program, fitness and wellness reimbursement, and HSA and FSA options.
* **Life –** Employer-paid STD and LTD, employer-paid term life insurance, and retirement 401(k) with company match.
* **Community –** Quarterly social events, paid group volunteering events, and employee networks and groups.

***How Your Career Will Grow:***

We know career growth is not always linear or streamlined—it’s often squiggly. You may want to explore a management track, try a new technical track, or move laterally to reposition your skills and talents. No matter what level you join us at or how you want to shape your career, we want Consor to be a place where you can learn and grow.

***Why*** ***You’ll*** ***Love Consor:***

At Consor, you’ll work with a network of water and transportation professionals who specialize in planning, engineering design, structural assessment, and construction services. Across geographies, you’ll have access to the resources and nationwide expertise found in a large consulting firm, while experiencing a community feel at the local level. You’ll experience a culture (opens in new window) where we share in our successes and support one another through challenges. Here, there are countless opportunities to explore your career path by working on projects that help you expand your potential and take your career to new heights! Join our diverse team of experts who live and work alongside client partners, providing thoughtful solutions to create inspiring communities together.

Consor welcomes and celebrates equality and diversity in the workplace. Throughout our teams and across leadership, Consor pursues an environment in which each employee and prospective employee is treated respectfully, valuing the uniqueness of individuals and differing perspectives and experiences. At the heart of this is ensuring employment practices at Consor provide and promote equal employment and development opportunity for all employees and prospective employees, in accordance with all local, state, and federal laws and regulations governing personnel activities. San Mateo, CA, United StatesProject ManagementID: 28864

  

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

### **About Roblox Live**

Roblox Live **creates the moments that bring Roblox together**. We turn music, entertainment, culture, and the creativity of our community into new ways to play and connect. From major platform celebrations to live performances and breakout creator moments, we give players something to show up for, experience with friends, and come back to.

We’re a small, fast-moving team with the ambition to **shape the future of live experiences on Roblox**. We bring ideas to life with creators and partners, build the technology that makes them possible, and turn what works into tools that let the creator community take it further.

### **The Role**

We’re looking for a **Senior Program Manager** to turn our slate of live experiences into a coordinated program. You will own the calendar, cross-team dependencies, budget ask, risk register, executive communications, and post-event playbooks. You will help shape new programs early, bringing ideas on formats and audience hooks, then build the plan that takes them through launch and learning.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can turn ambiguity into a plan and lead across teams through trust and judgment. You’ll work closely with creative, content, product, engineering, marketing, safety, and external partners. You’ll align the program around shared goals, partner with the Live Ops Producer on launch readiness and event-day escalations, and give leadership a clear view of progress and decisions.

### **You Will:**

* Turn the programming slate into a forward calendar with clear phases, milestones, decision gates, and owners. Manage dependencies and resource conflicts across events in concept, production, and live operation.
* Help define each program’s audience, goals, and success measures. Bring creative and operational judgment to early concepts, and make practical recommendations on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs.
* Build and maintain one shared view of program status. Establish how workstream owners update plans, track commitments, and resolve blockers across internal teams and partners.
* Run focused planning sessions, workstream reviews, and recaps that keep decisions moving. Partner with technical leads on feasibility and with the Live Ops Producer on readiness milestones.
* Consolidate staffing, studio, vendor, and production estimates into a program budget request. Partner with Finance and workstream owners to track commitments, spend, and changes against the approved plan.
* Maintain the risk register, including assumptions, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans. Assign owners, surface risks early, and recommend changes that protect the program’s goals and delivery dates.
* Give executives concise updates on outcomes, progress, risks, and decisions needed. Give workstream owners the detail they need to act, with clear commitments and next steps.
* Establish decision owners and escalation paths before launch. Support the Live Ops Producer during live events by resolving cross-team dependencies and coordinating leadership decisions and communications.
* Lead retrospectives and publish post-event readouts with Data Science and functional leads. Track program results, partner contributions, and creative concepts against the goals set before launch.
* Turn lessons and operating runbooks into reusable program playbooks. Track follow-up actions and improve planning, handoffs, and reporting so each event starts with what the team has already learned.

### **You Have**

* 7+ years in program management, production, or live operations, including 3+ years leading live events, recurring content programs, or partner programs.
* A track record of building and running complex programs across creative, technical, and business teams, with multiple initiatives moving at once.
* Experience consolidating budget requests, tracking program financials, and managing risks and dependencies through delivery.
* Strong judgment about scope, priorities, and escalation, with the ability to make progress before every detail is settled.
* Proven ability to lead without formal authority and build lasting trust with internal teams and external partners.
* Clear writing and executive communication, with experience connecting program activity to measurable outcomes.
* Fluency with program management tools such as Jira, Airtable, Asana, or equivalents, and the ability to build practical tracking and reporting systems.
* Experience in gaming, creator platforms, entertainment, live events, or esports (preferred).
* Experience building a program or operating model from scratch that other teams adopted (preferred).
* Familiarity with Roblox and its player and creator communities (preferred).
* Experience evaluating partner programs or creative concepts through shared goals and scorecards (preferred).

**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### **About the role**

New hires join Anthropic every week; their first days here shape how they understand our mission and culture, and help to accelerate their time to productivity. We're looking for a Program Manager to own the live delivery of our new hire onboarding program, so that every cohort, whatever its size or timing, gets an experience that is well run, welcoming, and grounded in what makes Anthropic distinctive.

You'll own our San Francisco onboarding program end to end: facilitating sessions, overseeing the operating rhythm behind each cohort, and orchestrating across Recruiting, People Services, Workplace, IT, and the many presenters who bring the program to life. You'll work within our overall onboarding strategy and program design, and your job is to deliver our live onboarding program reliably, week after week, while spotting where the experience can get better and feeding those insights into how the program evolves.

This role suits someone who loves the craft of running a great program: the preparation, the moments in the room, and the systems that make it all repeatable at scale. You'll do well here if you stay calm when plans change, care deeply about the details that shape a first impression, and bring warmth and clarity to a room of people on their first day.

This role requires being in the office at least two days a week – on all programming days and as needed otherwise.

### **Key responsibilities**

* **Own weekly program delivery:** Run each onboarding cohort from pre-arrival readiness through program close, so every cohort gets a consistent, high-quality experience

* **Set the weekly operating rhythm:** Prioritize and sequence program logistics and coordination work each week, making sure nothing falls through the cracks
* **Support improvements to the program's operating system:** Partner closely with the NHO coordinator to improve run-of-show documents, checklists, playbooks, and automations that make the program repeatable, reduce single points of failure, and flex with variable cohort sizes
* **Track program health:** Monitor operational and experience metrics via new hire feedback, surface trends and friction points, and bring recommendations that inform program design and priorities
* **Drive content improvement:** Based on new hire feedback and company needs, work with facilitators and the broader onboarding team to iterate on and improve program content over time
* **Plan ahead for what could change:** Anticipate cohort size swings, holidays, space constraints, and last-minute changes, with contingency plans ready before they're needed

### **Minimum qualifications**

jobs.title: Permitting Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Sterling Homes

Sterling Homes is a fast-growing luxury residential developer based in Silicon Valley, with **20+ active projects totaling $300M+**. We design and build high-end custom homes across **Cupertino, Los Altos, Saratoga, Atherton, and Menlo Park**. We are a small, founder-led team, and one person's follow-through can move a project's schedule by months.

**The Role**  
We are looking for a Permitting & Entitlements Manager to own the path from design to permit issuance across about 12 active projects. You will keep every application moving and keep architects, engineers, consultants and city planners accountable. You will make sure nothing stalls in someone's inbox. You will report to our Chief Operating Officer.  
We care more about how you work than about how many permits you've pulled. If you have spent your career pushing people to get things done, and you're organized and persistent enough to learn the permitting process quickly, we want to hear from you.  
**What You'll Do**

* Manage building permit and entitlement applications from pre-application through permit issuance for our projects
* Lead SB 9 lot splits and related other entitlement related approvals
* Work with cities in Santa Clara and San Mateo counties through online portals and occasional visits to the permit counter
* Coordinate architects, structural and civil engineers, surveyors, arborists and other consultants so plan-check comments are answered completely and on time
* Track every submittal, comment cycle, fee, and deadline. Follow up relentlessly with city staff and consultants until each item is resolved
* Keep project status up to date in Buildertrend and give leadership clear weekly updates on where each permit stands and what is blocking it
* Spot risks early, such as missing documents, conflicting requirements, or long review queues, and bring solutions, not just problems
* Build and refine our internal permitting playbooks as you learn each city's requirements

**What We're Looking For**

* Senior-level professional experience (typically 5+ years) in a role that required coordinating many parties and driving work to completion
* Relevant backgrounds include:
* project coordinator at an architecture firm
* planning or permit technician at a city or county
* title or escrow coordinator
* permit expediter
* project management in construction or real estate
* Exceptional follow-up habits. You don't wait to be asked twice, and you don't let things fall through the cracks
* Strong written communication. Your emails to planners and consultants are clear, polite, and get answered
* Highly organized, and comfortable managing many deadlines at once
* Able to learn quickly and pick up new regulations and processes on your own
* Works on-site at our Cupertino office, with occasional travel to Peninsula cities

**Nice to Have**

* Ability to read architectural and construction plan sets
* Experience with construction management software (Buildertrend, Procore or similar)
* Familiarity with Bay Area permitting, SB 9 or residential entitlements

**Compensation**

* Base salary: $100,000 +, depending on experience
* Performance bonus tied to permit timelines

Job Type: Full-time

Base Pay: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* What are your salary expectations?
* When can you start?
* Which of these have you done? Select all that apply.

- Submitted building permit applications  
- Responded to plan check comments  
- Worked at a city or county permit or planning counter  
- Coordinated architects, engineers or consultants  
- Title or escrow coordination  
- Read architectural or construction plan sets  
- Used Buildertrend, Procore or similar software  
- None of the above

Experience:

* residential construction management: 5 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Cupertino, CA 95014 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Translational project manager
jobs.description:
**About Serova**

Serova builds personalized cancer vaccines. Each vaccine is made for the individual patient from their own samples and given in partnership with their treating physician. Our science runs from early, curiosity-driven lab work to vaccines given to patients, and this role connects the two.

**The role**

You'll sit between our early, curiosity-driven preclinical science and clinical translation, including trials. You'll take promising lab results and turn them into programs that reach patients: setting the plan, coordinating the teams, and driving go/no-go decisions on each candidate.

**What you'll do**

* Run each blood-directed vaccine program from lab results to first patients
* Get wet lab, bioinformatics, manufacturing, regulatory and clinical onto one timeline, and cut turnaround per patient
* Present patient-level results and program progress, and drive go/no-go decisions on candidates
* Manage our sequencing and CLIA lab partners to shorten turnaround
* Pull together the inputs for protocols, IND submissions and publications
* Coordinate with clinical on the observational and biobank studies that feed the programs

**Who you are**

* A scientist turned program leader who has run personalized therapy programs end to end
* You know the science well enough to make the call
* You keep everyone on one timeline
* High agency, friendly and low ego

**Requirements**

* A PhD in genetics, immunology, computational biology or a related field
* 3+ years leading translational or clinical programs across scientific, clinical and operations teams
* Based in the San Francisco Bay Area or London, or willing to relocate
* Authorized to work in the US or UK, or a realistic path to get there

**What will make you stand out**

* Personalized cancer vaccine or neoantigen programs, ideally across several trials
* Immunogenomics: neoantigen pipelines and tumor sequencing
* FDA-regulated, IND-enabled trials, with published outcomes
* You've worked with CLIA labs to speed up clinical sample turnaround
* Program leadership at a diagnostics or therapeutics company
* You've led and mentored teams of scientists

**Details**

* **Location:** San Francisco or London
* **Type:** Full-time

jobs.title: Program Manager, Student Collective (FTC, 12 months)
jobs.description:
**About OpenAI**
----------------

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We build models and products that help people learn, create, and solve problems safely and responsibly.

**About the team**
------------------

The Community team builds direct relationships with people using OpenAI’s technology, brings their insights to product and research teams, and shares useful examples so others can learn from them.

The Student Community team is building OpenAI Student Collective, a global program that equips students with community, resources, and support to help their peers build AI capability, confidence, and opportunity. Students are often among the first to discover new ways to learn, build, create, and organize with AI. Our job is to find those examples, support the students behind them, and help their stories travel.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented program manager to run Student Collective’s daily operations and improve how the team works as it grows. You’ll manage student communications, program records and activity logistics, while identifying opportunities to improve our tools, workflows and team coordination.

Program leads set priorities and make program decisions. You’ll own day-to-day workflows, propose improvements and put agreed changes into practice, using sound judgment to escalate risks or exceptions early.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* **Own program tools, task tracking and data.** Evolve how the team uses Airtable, Slack, Google Workspace and project-management tools to track tasks, owners and deadlines, spot gaps and keep work moving. Keep student details, agreement status, access and participation records accurate; test AI-assisted workflows, automations and simple sites to reduce manual work.
* **Manage onboarding and access follow-up.** Track outstanding agreements and access issues, prepare Slack and subscription requests for authorized colleagues, and verify completion. Support offboarding when needed.
* **Manage student communications.** Respond to program questions, track follow-ups through resolution and escalate exceptions to program leads with clear context.
* **Coordinate program scheduling.** Arrange interviews, student check-ins and meetings across time zones; manage invitations, rescheduling and follow-ups.
* **Support procurement and payments.** Prepare Zip requests, collect supplier details and track invoice and payment status. Work with Procurement and IT to resolve issues for agency and internal partners.
* **Support student projects and events.** Track project and event requests, coordinate approved purchases and shipping, and follow up on receipts, returns, check-ins and recaps.
* **Coordinate Product Lab logistics.** Maintain participant lists and check-in records, schedule sessions, follow up on missing responses and flag access or eligibility issues.
* **Improve team communications and reporting.** Establish a clear rhythm for meetings and updates so the right people can see progress, decisions, blockers and where support is needed. Track follow-through, propose and implement workflow improvements with program leads, and maintain current instructions and templates.

**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------

* Strong attention to detail, accurate recordkeeping, and reliable follow-through.
* Hands-on comfort using AI tools to build and improve workflows, create automations and simple sites, and test whether they save time or improve accuracy.
* Familiarity with procurement workflows, supplier coordination and payment tracking, and a willingness to learn the team’s Zip process.
* Clear, proactive communication with students and cross-functional partners, including concise updates, meeting follow-through and early flags when support is needed.
* Confidence identifying process gaps, proposing practical improvements and carrying agreed changes through to implementation.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, manage competing deadlines, and advance work independently, with sound judgment about when to seek guidance.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Calendar, Gmail, Docs, and Sheets, as well as Slack and Airtable.

**Preferred experience**

* Experience supporting students or communities, coordinating suppliers, or maintaining operational databases

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence—bringing a broad perspective to problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to team-level goals for cross-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment and the ability to work across a range of variable, often ambiguous risk factors.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering programs for a loosely defined area of work, aligning solutions across teams, and advising cross-functional partners as a subject-matter expert on complex matters in your area.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging.
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high-pressure, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

jobs.description:
**Title:** **Case** **Management** **Program** **Manager**

**Classification**: **Full-time, Exempt**

**Reports** **to:** **Chief of Staff**

**Supervises:** **Case Managers and Patient Navigators**

**Annual Salary $80,000-$95,000**

ABOUT RITTER CENTER:

For over 40 years, Ritter Center has worked to prevent and resolve homelessness and improve the health, dignity, and well-being of people living in poverty in Marin.

When you join Ritter Center, you join a highly trained staff that combines national clinical best practices with a whole-person care approach to solving each person’s medical and mental health, housing, and food needs.

We are growing to meet the needs of our community. We are looking for staff who are ready for a career with a mission-driven organization, want to be valued, have diverse experience, and have compassion. If this sounds like you, we would love to have you join us!

**All positions at Ritter Center require a background check and Livescan fingerprinting.**

**Please visit our jobs page on our** **website** **for a complete list of our employee benefits.**  
  
Ritter Center is currently recruiting for a Program Manager for our Case Management Department. This full-time, exempt position reports to the Chief of Staff based in San Rafael, CA; the role ***operates out of our main Campus.***

The Case Management Program Manager is an integral role in Ritter Center’s dynamic multidisciplinary team of medical, behavioral health and case management professionals who provide integrated care to our target population. This position reports directly to the Chief of Staff and supervises a team of 7 employees comprised of 3 Case Managers and 3 Patient Navigators and 1 Admin Coordinator. The Program Manager also provides a limited amount of direct client services while managing the work of the team. The services are: Representative Payee, Patient Navigation, Rapid Rehousing funds, Housing First (HBCM), and Custody to Community. This position also serves as the Agency Lead for the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) to ensure timely and accurate data entry across all agency HMIS users. This role leads efforts to triage all drop-in case management and referral services and oversees the coordination of overall client flow.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Recruit, hire, train and supervise a team of Case Managers and Patient Navigators providing trauma-informed care across a comprehensive and diverse range of programs to ensure effective services and outcomes.
* Conduct regular team meetings and individual supervision sessions.
* Oversee the day-to-day operations, service quality, and client flow of Case Management programs while ensuring compliance with all legal, regulatory, contractual, and funding requirements.
* Meet regularly with Chief of Staff and attend staff meetings and training as scheduled.
* Function as a part of a multidisciplinary team to support the engagement and services for chronically homeless individuals and families with severe and persistent mental illness, physical disabilities, and/or substance use.
* Collaborate with Accounting to verify compliance and accurate tracking of Housing First rental subsidy payments, Rapid Rehousing payments, Rental Assistance payments, Representative Payee accounts management and Social Security reporting.
* Attend and represent Ritter Center at all required County level case conferencing, advocacy, and policy meetings as well as community events and media appearances when requested.
* Oversee accurate record-keeping, documentation, reporting, and retention of client and program records within HMIS and other organizational systems.
* Partner with the Clinical staff to ensure integration of clinical services.
* Supervise and provide strategic direction for case management staff, including leading meetings, performance evaluations, and professional coaching.
* Ensure effective onboarding, performance management, and policy adherence of staff supervised.
* Maintain high staff morale to enable a positive and inclusive culture.
* Work collaboratively to enhance service integration within the organization and non-profit community partners throughout Marin County.
* Serve as a member of the leadership team. Contribute to the development of and adhere to Ritter Center’s goals, objectives, policies and procedures.
* Support Quality Improvement (QI) activities; collect, analyze and report data regarding client services according to all case management contracts as well as organizational-wide QI measures.
* Collaborate closely with Marin County Continuum of Care (CoC) partner Community Based Organizations (CBO), and other Social Service agencies to ensure appropriate support and referrals are being made by the team.
* Oversee resolution of complex service challenges and guide staff in developing effective approaches and solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Per our Federally Qualified Healthcare Center (FQHC) requirements employment at Ritter Center requires compliance with being able to produce a negative TB test prior to the start of employment, as well as being vaccinated against COVID-19 (unless applying for an exemption) per the August 5, 2020 State Public Order for Healthcare Facilities, providers and employees.
* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, Criminal Justice, or another behavioral or social science field.
* Equivalent experience (2+ years) in benefits administration, Representative Payee services, case management, or a closely related field. Additional experience may be substituted for a degree.
* Experience with social services in Marin County is highly preferred.
* Prior management experience in a social services setting, including employee supervision, implementation of new service models, program management, and ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with budgeting and accounting practices is highly preferred.
