jobs.title: Junior Project Coordinator Internship (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
**About Scale**
---------------

For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.

Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.

We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.

Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.

If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.

**About The Role**
------------------

We're looking for a highly organized, detail-driven **Junior Project Coordinator** to keep our creative and development teams moving. You'll own weekly sprint planning for our Design team, keep tickets moving by following up with stakeholders, and keep our project management workspace in Wrike accurate and up to date.

This is a great entry-level opportunity for someone looking to grow in project coordination. You'll work closely with designers, developers, and project managers, gaining hands-on experience with sprint planning and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

This is a fully remote, part-time, standalone role at 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Pacific. You'll report to Krystal Perez, Project Manager, and support our Design and Software Development teams as well as our Project Managers. Within your first 60 days, you'll run the weekly sprint review independently and manage stakeholder follow-ups with minimal oversight.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Design Sprint Planning & Prioritization (Core Focus)**

* Build and prioritize the Design team's weekly sprint using established guidelines.
* Check in with each designer at the end of every week to confirm what's complete, what's carrying over, and why.
* Lead a weekly call with brand project managers to review sprint priorities and discuss tickets planned for upcoming sprints.

### **Stakeholder Follow-Up & Blocker Management**

* Follow up with ticket stakeholders when work is blocked by slow reviews, open questions, or missing information.
* Schedule touch-base calls at the start of a sprint for design tickets that need more detailed alignment beyond the brief.
* Escalate to your manager when a mission-critical item is still at risk, or when a ticket has had no movement for 3 to 4 days.
* Provide the same follow-up and escalation support for Software Development tickets.

### **Daily Ticket Assignment**

* Assign daily quick-turn tickets to the two designated designers, following a documented SOP.
* Confirm each ticket has the details a designer needs before it's assigned.

### **Project Manager Support**

* Help project managers build out new key projects in Wrike, including tasks, timelines, assignees, and fields.

### **Wrike Maintenance & Data Quality**

* Keep Wrike accurate and organized by updating statuses, cleaning up stale or duplicate items, and filling in missing fields.
* Help build out the Wrike onboarding space currently in development, including organizing resources and how-to content.
* Review new requests for missing information and send them back to requesters before they reach the team.

### **Reporting & Data Cleanup**

* Clean up monthly ticket data used for team productivity and workload reporting, and follow up with stakeholders on any missing information.
* Spot-check dashboards and automated status updates to confirm they're pulling correctly.
* Draft routine internal updates, reminders, and announcements for review.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* **Follow-Through:** Tracks open items to resolution and follows up independently.
* **Proactive Communication:** Seeks clarification at the start of a task and flags blockers or deadline risks as soon as they arise.
* **Responsiveness:** Replies promptly to Slack messages and Wrike comments during working hours.
* **Accuracy:** Keeps due dates, assignees, statuses, and ticket details correct and current.
* **Professional Communication:** Writes clear, polished, and concise messages to stakeholders at all levels.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* A bachelor's degree with at least one administrative, coordination, or project support internship, or 1 to 2 years of administrative experience.
* Hands-on experience with a project management tool such as Wrike, Asana, Monday.com, Jira, ClickUp, or Trello.
* Polished, professional written communication, especially in Slack and project management tools.
* A proven habit of following up independently and meeting deadlines.
* Comfort asking questions and raising blockers early.
* Availability to work 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Pacific, Monday to Friday.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with Wrike specifically.
* Experience supporting creative, design, marketing, or software development teams.
* Familiarity with agile or sprint-based workflows.
* Comfort with Google Workspace, Slack, and basic spreadsheet work like sorting, filtering, and cleaning data.

**What We Offer**

* Salary: $25 per hour
* Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance
* Fully remote, full-time position
* Monthly work-from-home stipend
* Generous paid time off program
* Discounted products
* An amazing team to work alongside

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Title:** ***Service Project Coordinator***

**Working Pattern:** ***Full Time***

**Working location:** ***Lockport, Louisiana***

*Relocation assistance is not available for this position.*

  

**Why Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

  

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.

  

You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is **Infinite Potential** . And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.

  

**Position Summary**

*The Service Project Coordinator supports the execution of large-engine service projects by coordinating warranty activities, financial reporting, project administration, invoicing, and government contract requirements. This role serves as a key partner to Service Managers, Finance, and operational teams to ensure projects are executed efficiently, customer commitments are fulfilled, and financial performance is accurately tracked. Through strong coordination and operational oversight, the position contributes directly to service excellence and business performance across the Large Engine Services organization. The individual in this role will be required to be onsite on a hybrid basis at the customer location in Lockport, Louisiana to focus on assisting technicians, reporting, and monitoring job progression on the customer site.*

  

**What you will be doing**

* *Coordinate the administrative and financial execution of large-engine service projects, including labor tracking, invoicing, quotations, purchase requests, parts management, tooling records, and project documentation.*

* *Manage warranty and work-in-progress activities by tracking claims, supporting failure analysis processes, monitoring open items, and partnering with internal stakeholders to drive timely resolution.*

* *Analyze project financial data, revenue projections, and controlling reports, providing visibility and support for operational decision-making and project performance improvements.*

* *Support government contracts and customer projects by coordinating documentation, invoice submissions, records management, and compliance with applicable customer and contractual requirements.*

* *Partner with Service Managers, Engineering, Finance, and global stakeholders to coordinate corrective actions, improve service execution processes, and support successful project delivery.*

* *Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% of the time to customer sites located around the globe and US Coast Guard Bases. This position will be located in Lockport, Louisiana when travel is not required.*

  

**Basic Requirements:**

* *Associate's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field and at least 3 years of experience in service project coordination, project administration, customer support, warranty administration, or a related field; OR*

* *Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field and at least 1 year of experience in service project coordination, project administration, customer support, warranty administration, or a related field; OR*

* *Master's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, or a related field; OR*

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations team manages payroll processing and services across 80+ countries around the world. As Rippling continues expanding globally, we are looking for a hyper-focused, customer-obsessed Escalations Lead to serve as our primary champion for customer experience when critical issues arise. This role is driven by a desire to make rapid, lasting improvements that immediately impact the experience of both our largest enterprise accounts and our smallest growing businesses.

You are part technical detective and part cross-functional project manager. When sticky, high-friction problems hit, you jump straight into action, unraveling complex scenarios into actionable components. You possess a deep understanding of our product behavior, thrive on rigorous root-cause analysis, and are relentless about driving end-to-end fixes alongside R&D counterparts, internal ops, and cross-functional leadership. You build trust effortlessly with customers, communicate with exceptional clarity, and translate frontline operational friction into high-value product roadmap items.

This is a high-visibility opportunity offering deep exposure to global product operations and an immediate, direct impact on our product quality and customer retention.

**What you will do**

* **Own end-to-end management of executive escalations:** Serve as the subject-matter expert and drive resolution of complex, cross-functional problems. Orchestrate internal stakeholders to collaborate efficiently, demonstrating control and leadership in high-stakes situations. Communicate complex scenarios with simple, clear, and strategic written and verbal communications.
* **Customer Management and Communication:** Jump into high-stakes customer escalations to stabilize critical issues and build immediate trust. Deconstruct problems into crisp updates for our customers and internal stakeholders.
* **Project Manage Incidents:** Bring structure to high-friction situations by coordinating action plans, ownership, and cross-functional execution.
* **Root-Cause Analysis:** Unravel complex technical and operational issues into actionable components, leading RCAs to prevent recurrence. When an incident or customer escalation arises, you rapidly root cause the situation and develop a plan forward.
* **Analyze trends and root causes**: Conduct thorough root cause analysis on each escalation to identify trends and drive effective process improvement. Share trends analysis with executive leadership.
* **Partner directly with customers**: Engage with customers to navigate complex challenges, resolve critical issues, and strengthen their trust in Rippling’s products and services.
* **Drive End-to-End Fixes:** Partner relentlessly with R&D and Ops to deliver durable fixes and critical roadmap items

**What you will need**
----------------------

* **3+ Years Experience:** Escalations Management, TPM, Account Management, Strategic Customer Support, or Operations at a fast-growing tech company.
* **Obsessive Customer Focus:** Passion for user experience and a track record of building immediate trust in high-stress moments.
* **High Focus and Ability to Handle Pressure:** Hyper-focused under pressure with a strong bias for action during critical incidents.
* **Product & Technical Curiosity:** Deep drive to understand product behavior and perform rigorous root-cause analysis.
* **R&D Partnership:** Strong collaborative muscle to influence Product, Engineering, and CX on permanent fixes.
* **Structured Communication:** Ability to break down complex issues into clear, actionable steps for both technical and executive audiences. Adept at managing communications for both internal and external stakeholders.
* Extremely driven and ambitious with a bias for action
* Have a solid track record of achievement - e.g., consistently delivered measurable business impact, quickly assumed increasing responsibility, or earned competitive recognition/ awards
* Quick learner with the ability to adapt to a fast-paced, high-growth environment
* Have excellent written and verbal communication in English with a strong attention to detail
* Ability to partner cross-functionally with a sense of urgency and influence without authority
* Previous experience in a fast-growth startup is preferred but not required

jobs.description:
**WHY DO WE NEED YOU?**

This execution-oriented position will play a critical role in the realization of the Infrastructure & Commercial Product Group (ICPG) growth strategy. Supporting the full ICPG portfolio, this includes the coordination and project management of priority initiatives with an emphasis on commercial execution, process improvement and the effective adoption of GenAI tools.

This project manager will be relied upon for effective communication, including with senior team members, BU general managers and functional experts. Managing multiple initiatives simultaneously and without direct reports, a successful candidate will rely upon their ability to connect, influence and support colleagues within ICPG and across the broader organization to obtain successful project outcomes. Supported by an internal champion on each project, they will lead the appropriate resources through all phases of a project, including scoping, planning, execution, completion/hand-off and post-mortem process improvement. They will be relied upon to effectively communicate project status, risks, mitigation and timeline, contributing directly to progress and/or escalating as required to ensure project teams meet or exceed stated objectives. Project duration will vary.

In parallel with project execution activities, this role will help to guide ICPG’s acceleration of GenAI adoption. This includes supporting the development of a GenAI roadmap (in concert with ICPG leadership) and the execution of priority GenAI implementation projects. Considered a vital component of ICPG’s growth strategy, it is expected that up to 50% of this role will be supporting the identification, justification and execution of projects in this dynamic space.

This role requires strong judgement, an openness to debate, the ability prioritize and a willingness to effectively navigate both ambiguity and conflict.

 **IS THIS JOB FOR YOU?**

***Essential Functions:***

**Project Management and Coordination**

* Define project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with management, project sponsors, relevant functional experts and other stakeholders.
* Effectively communicate expectations to project team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion, continuously manage objectives, and hold project team members accountable for delivery.
* Develop and track relevant project metrics to ensure alignment with objectives (outcome, budget, timeline). Intervene and escalate as required.
* Lead execution by helping project teams maintain an overall project vision with supporting detailed project plans.
* Proactively manage changes in project scope, identify potential roadblocks and devise contingency plans and mitigation.
* Maintain forward progress by making clear recommendations with incomplete information - maintaining optionality and managing risk through frequent and effective communication.
* Develop and deliver progress reports to management and project stakeholders including issue/action item logs, project status cards, risks and recommended/active mitigation.
* Conduct real-time and post-project reviews to recommend and make process adjustments in the spirit of continuous improvement.
* As required to execute the above, coordinate travel logistics, meeting requirements, deployment of collaboration tools, etc.

  

**GenAI Project Portfolio & Project Management**

* Contribute to the development of a GenAI roadmap for ICPG, coordinated and aligned with broader SGNA and Saint-Gobain global initiatives. This includes developing a framework (in conjunction with subject matter experts) to identify, screen and define projects/opportunities.
* Work with ICPG stakeholders to review project opportunities, define objectives, quantify expected impacts and prioritize resources – coordinating with SGNA IT as required.
* As projects are selected, serve as project manager for approved and justified ICPG GenAI projects (see project management expectations above).

 **Legal Statement**

Saint-Gobain provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Saint-Gobain is an equal opportunity employer of individuals with disabilities and supports the hiring of veterans.

 **A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US**

Saint-Gobain provides a comprehensive Total Rewards package designed to support employees and their families. We believe in the importance of pay transparency and are committed to providing candidates with clear compensation information.

The salary range for this position is $111,00 to $177,000 annually. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for an annual incentive bonus. The total target cash range for this position, including base salary and target bonus, is $127,600 to $203,500.

Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, experience, education, skills, internal equity, and business needs. Bonus payments are based on company and individual performance and are not guaranteed.

jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence—bringing a broad perspective to problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to team-level goals for cross-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment and the ability to work across a range of variable, often ambiguous risk factors.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering programs for a loosely defined area of work, aligning solutions across teams, and advising cross-functional partners as a subject-matter expert on complex matters in your area.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging.

* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high-pressure, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills to improve processes or resolve complex issues
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience in managing cross-functional projects and teams
* Experience in leveraging AI and data-driven insights to continuously improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of a process
* Experience with product development lifecycles and complex systems

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. jobs.title: Patient Engagement Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
Accompany Health is on a mission to give patients with complex needs the dignified, high-quality care they deserve but rarely receive. A primary, behavioral, and social care provider, Accompany Health walks alongside patients for their entire care journey, offering at-home and virtual care, as well as 24/7 support. Partnering with innovative payors, Accompany Health is powered by remarkable care teams, elegant technology, and a commitment to evidence-based practice.  
  
We build long-term relationships with our patients so they know, without question, that our team is here for them day or night, year after year. We focus on the health outcomes most important to our patients to make it clear that they lead the way.  
  
To achieve our mission, we collaborate with community-based organizations, local providers, and health plans. Led by our empathetic care teams, guided by proven care models, and powered by our own technology, we deliver a level of service that our communities rightfully deserve but rarely receive.  
  
While our headquarters is in Bethesda, MD, our teams are distributed across the country. If you're eager to make a tangible difference in people's lives, to help correct long-standing disparities in health care, join us.

***About the role:***

The Patient Engagement Coordinator plays a central role in ensuring that our patients receive consistent, high-quality engagement and are supported in maintaining their ongoing care.

This role will focus on reaching out to existing Accompany Health patients to schedule Annual Visits, follow-up appointments with clinicians, and provide gentle reminders, answer questions, and reinforce the value of our continuous support. Your work will help patients stay engaged with their care teams and build stronger relationships with us over time.

This is a high-volume outbound call role. You will spend the majority of your workday on back-to-back outbound calls, with a target of 135+ calls per day (subject to change as business needs evolve). Success in this role requires the ability to maintain energy, focus, and warmth across a full day of calls — this is not a role for someone who tires of phone work. Your success is measured by your ability to deliver an outstanding patient experience, ensure continuity of care, and maintain accurate records.

* **This role is a full-time, contract position, with an end date of 02/01/2027**

***Responsibilities will include:***

* Conduct outbound calls, texts, and other virtual outreach to schedule Annual Visits and follow-up appointments with existing patients
* Maintain a daily outbound call target of 135+ calls, working through structured call queues in our internal CRM tools throughout the day
* Send SMS and message-based outreach to patients to confirm appointments and follow up on scheduling
* Navigate and maintain records across internal CRM systems and spreadsheets simultaneously during and after calls
* Educate patients on the importance of ongoing care and the benefits of completing their annual visits and any necessary follow-up appointments with clinicians
* Handle calls from patients with warmth and professionalism, answering questions and directing them appropriately
* Collaborate closely with clinical care teams to ensure alignment on visit readiness and follow-ups
* Provide an empathetic, respectful, and encouraging patient experience on every call
* Monitor scheduling metrics and contribute to achieving engagement goals, maintaining both call volume targets and service quality
* Act as a liaison between patients and the care team to address basic concerns and questions about services

***What makes you a fit for the team:***

* Excellent communicator with a warm, patient-first mindset
* Empathetic listener who can connect with a wide variety of individuals, especially seniors and those with complex needs
* Comfortable with high-volume, structured call workflows, energized rather than drained by back-to-back outbound calls throughout the day
* + If you are not energized by the idea of making a high volume of calls every day, this role is not the right fit
  + We are looking for people who thrive in a structured, high-output environment and take pride in working through a full call queue while still delivering an exceptional patient experience
* Able to maintain warmth, professionalism, and energy across a full day
* Motivated by helping others succeed in their healthcare journey
* Able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-moving, remote-first environment
* Comfortable working across multiple tools simultaneously, including CRM systems, spreadsheets, and SMS platforms

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Required
* + High School Diploma/GED or higher
  + 2+ years of related experience in a high-volume outbound call environment, preferably in healthcare customer service or healthcare sales/direct marketing
  + Excellent patient communication skills, with the ability to quickly build trust and rapport with seniors and other patients
  + Strong computer skills and basic knowledge of G-Suite (e.g., Google Docs/Sheets)
  + Can handle multiple tasks at once, such as typing notes while talking and working in 2 systems at the same time
  + The first stage of the hiring process requires applicants to complete an internet speed test to ensure their connection meets the performance standards necessary for this position
* Preferred
* + Experience working in an Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system
  + Knowledge of Medicaid and/or Medicare programs and senior services
  + Ability to work after hours and weekends if needed

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

***A bit about this role:***

The Payment Integrity Inpatient Program Manager is responsible for overseeing assigned inpatient Payment Integrity programs, including audit, appeals, quality, and review processes across internal teams, offshore staff augmentation, and external vendors. This role is heavily focused on ensuring audit accuracy, timeliness, coding and clinical quality, regulatory compliance, consistency, and defensibility across all assigned program areas. The Program Manager is accountable not only for the quality of audit determinations but also for ensuring audits are reviewed within SLA and that inventory is actively managed to prevent backlogs.

The Program Manager partners closely with leadership and operational support teams to ensure audit workflows are executed effectively and on time while maintaining strong oversight of audit quality, turnaround performance, dispute outcomes, vendor performance, and adherence to organizational and regulatory standards.

***Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:***

* Perform complex and escalated inpatient Payment Integrity audits, including clinical validation, DRG coding validation, readmission, and hospital bill audit reviews, and provide clear, defensible audit rationale and determinations.
* Provide guidance and oversight to internal staff (offshore and stateside)) and external vendors, managing calibration sessions, feedback loops, education, and ongoing quality monitoring to ensure compliance and adherence to program expectations
* Develop and maintain program-specific training materials, audit guidance, review standards, and supporting documentation
* Perform quality reviews and trend analysis to ensure coding, clinical, and audit findings are accurate, defensible, and aligned with regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements
* Monitor program metrics, dispute trends, and vendor results, partnering with leadership to identify root causes, address quality concerns, and drive continuous improvement efforts
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex audit, coding, clinical, and escalation-related issues, serving as the primary subject matter expert for assigned program areas
* Support dispute and appeals management activities, including escalation review, audit rationale review, and corrective action planning
* Support the implementation of new audit concepts, review methodologies, and program enhancements to align with evolving business and regulatory needs

***Required skills and experience:***

* 2-3 years of experience in healthcare audit, Payment Integrity, coding review, clinical documentation review, or compliance
* Strong clinical and inpatient coding knowledge required; CCS, RHIA, RHIT, RN, or equivalent inpatient coding/clinical validation experience required. Demonstrated expertise in inpatient DRG coding and validation strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience with inpatient DRG assignment and validation, including ICD-10-CM coding, principal and secondary diagnosis assignment, MCC/CC identification, POA indicators, and inpatient clinical documentation review, as well as severity of illness/risk of mortality concepts and readmission logic.
* Demonstrated experience reviewing medical records to ensure audit accuracy, coding/clinical correctness, compliance, and defensibility of determinations
* Experience operating within structured audit programs, including applying defined criteria, documenting rationale, and ensuring consistency and quality of audit outcomes
* Ability to interpret clinical and/or coding documentation to support audit decisions and resolve documentation gaps or discrepancies
* Experience collaborating across clinical, coding, audit, and operational teams in a complex healthcare environment
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess audit trends, root causes, and documentation gaps impacting program performance and quality outcomes
* Strong operational discipline and the ability to stay organized amidst a wide variety of responsibilities
* Proven experience in training payment integrity audits

***Desired skills and experience:***

* Bachelor’s Degree
* Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage internal and external stakeholders
* Experience managing offshore vendors
* Ability to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* Curiosity and hands-on experience with AI tools, automation, or LLM-based workflows in operational settings

jobs.description:
**About Upstart**

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

**The Team:**

Upstart’s **Partner Implementation & Enablement** team is responsible for bringing new bank and credit union partners onto our platform and keeping existing partners equipped to run their lending programs. We own the operational core of the partner relationship: the diligence materials partners use to evaluate us, the change management process that tells them when our policies and models change, and the systems that deliver both. How quickly a partner can launch, and how much confidence they have in us once they have launched, is decided by this team’s work.

As the **Diligence Program Lead** at Upstart, you will own the diligence and change management programs our lending partners depend on. You will answer the due diligence questionnaires that partners and their examiners require, maintain the document library and access controls behind them, and run the recurring process that notifies partners when our policies, procedures, and models change. You will work across Compliance, Lending Partnerships, Account Management, and Product to turn a set of manual, individually held processes into programs that hold up as the partner base grows.

**How you’ll make an impact**

* Own the lending partner change management program end to end: assemble each release, notify partners of policy, procedure, and model updates, and keep the supporting document libraries current.
* Respond to lending partner due diligence questionnaires and information requests, working with Compliance, Legal, and Model Risk Management to source and verify every answer.
* Maintain the partner-facing document repository and its access controls, including which materials each partner can reach based on their product mix and stage in the relationship.
* Run the recurring corrective action reporting cycle: validate the source data, distribute partner-specific reports, and confirm delivery with the teams that publish them.
* Work with Product to move manual diligence and change management workflows onto supported tooling, and document each process so more than one person can run it.
* Identify gaps in policy ownership and documentation approval status, and raise them with Compliance and Lending Partnerships before they reach a partner.

**Minimum Qualificationsu**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
* 5 years of experience in financial services compliance, risk, audit, or third-party due diligence
* 2 years of experience responding to due diligence questionnaires, regulatory examinations, or audit requests from banks, credit unions, or other regulated institutions
* Experience owning a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, including its documentation
* Experience administering a document management system, virtual data room, or other controlled-access content repository

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of consumer lending products and the policies that govern them, including personal loans, auto, and home equity
* Knowledge of model risk management practices and how model documentation is shared with third parties
* Knowledge of third-party risk management expectations at banks and credit unions
* Skilled in using generative AI tools to draft, verify, and maintain large volumes of written documentation
* Ability to build process automation in spreadsheet or workflow tools and hand it off to others to run
* Ability to influence across compliance, legal, product, and commercial teams without direct authority

**Position location** This role is available in the following locations: Remote

**Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Confiz is currently seeking a Business Analyst to support one of our largest clients. This is a critical initiative to transition separate Consumer Care teams into a unified organizational design under Corporate Affairs. This transformation involves implementing a consolidated contact center vendor strategy that leverages a harmonized technology stack. The end-state solution aims to unlock synergy value by streamlining operations, sunsetting heritage Kellanova (K) technology, improving data quality and consistency, and elevating the consumer experience through the consolidation of technology and contact center vendors. A key enabler for this objective is the consolidated tech stack, which will harmonize Quality Metrics and related critical alert processes.

**Responsibilities**

**During Design Phase**

* Prepare user stories and detailed functional requirements for the harmonized Salesforce Service Cloud and connected technologies (e.g., Sprinklr) and interfaces.
* Actively contribute to the Salesforce Design process led by an external partner (Salesforce platform vendor).
* Support the development of key deliverables including Capabilities Blueprint & Prioritization, Future State Architecture, Persona Definitions & User Journeys, Data & Integration Design, Testing Strategy, Training Strategy, Deployment Strategy, Implementation Timeline/Budget/Resource Plan post design, and Future State Process Maps.
* Define data requirements and mappings, including identifying the need for records consolidation, migration, and designing data integration solutions.
* Analyze and document how processes and ways of working will be impacted by technology changes and vendor consolidations, recognizing that SFSC platform changes will affect contact handling processes and system look/feel.
* Contribute to understanding how the consolidated tech stack will enable the harmonization of M/K Quality Metrics and related critical alert processes, including the impact of data model changes on Quality metric reporting.

**During Execution & Regional Deployments**

* Support the build and test phases for the integrated technology stack, collaborating closely with Salesforce vendors, DT Project Managers, Testers, and Data / Integration leads.
* Lead or support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities to ensure that implemented solutions meet the defined business requirements and user needs.
* Play a key role in Data Mapping/Conversion/Migration/Validation efforts, supporting labor associated with moving legacy Kellanova data into the new harmonized system and ensuring data quality and consistency.
* Provide expertise and training/release support during regional deployments across all in-scope areas, including Accelerator, AMEA, Europe, LatAm, and North America.
* Address specific functional and technical requirements for the China region deployment, ensuring Salesforce is implemented in compliance with local legal and security constraints while aiming for a global model.
* Collaborate with Digital Technology teams to maintain and evolve data flows to Azure and Power BI for analytics and reporting.

**General/Throughout Project Lifecycle:**

* Act as a crucial liaison between business stakeholders (e.g., Corporate Affairs, Commercial, Q&FS, Finance, Growth/Marketing, P&O, Legal) and technical teams, translating complex business needs into technical specifications and vice versa.
* Support efforts related to the decommissioning of legacy Kellanova platforms and the renegotiation of technology contracts, contributing to the realization of synergy value.
* Contribute to change management, communications, release, and training efforts to facilitate adoption by affected end-users.

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst, specifically in the Digital Technology (DT) domain.

This role drives consistent service delivery, manages escalations within the team, and champions a customer-first culture grounded in accountability and continuous improvement.

This role is expected to apply AI tools and modern support practices to improve team productivity, knowledge quality, and customer outcomes. Reports to the Director, Customer Care.

In the USA, this job profile is **EXEMPT** and will be not eligible for paid overtime.

We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

As Manager of our Pooled Customer Success team, you will lead a team of 4 to 7 Customer Success Managers who share collective ownership of a large portfolio of customers. Your mandate is to build a high performing team that delivers consistent, measurable value across many accounts without the a named one to one relationship.

This is a different discipline from named account management. Success here comes from designing repeatable plays, prioritizing the right customers at the right moment, maintaining clean account context so any CSM can pick up any customer, and holding the team to response and follow through standards that protect retention at volume.

You are both an operator and a hands on coach. You build the coverage system, you improve it every quarter, and you develop CSMs who can move quickly, diagnose accurately, and create value in a compressed number of touchpoints.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of 4 to 7 pooled CSMs supporting a shared customer portfolio.

* Manage workload distribution, queue coverage, and capacity across the team so no customer segment goes unattended.

* Conduct regular portfolio reviews, renewal and risk reviews, and performance check ins.

* Coach CSMs on rapid discovery, efficient customer conversations, and getting to value in fewer, higher quality interactions.

* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

* Hire, onboard, and develop CSM talent suited to a fast moving, high volume environment.

* Driving Measurable Customer Value at Scale

* Operationalize our Customer Value Framework through standardized plays rather than bespoke plans.

* Ensure every customer in the pool receives defined lifecycle coverage, including onboarding confirmation, adoption checkpoints, and a structured pre renewal review.

* Establish clear value milestones and outcome criteria that apply consistently across the portfolio.

* Ensure product adoption is connected to tangible business results in every customer facing interaction.

* Monitor portfolio health signals and direct team effort toward the accounts where intervention changes the outcome.

**Retention, Expansion & Growth Alignment**  

* Own retention performance for the pooled portfolio, including renewal readiness and early risk detection.

* Partner closely with Renewals and Sales leadership on renewal strategy and expansion routing.

* Ensure CSMs surface new use cases, new stakeholders, and expansion signals and hand them off cleanly.

* Influence retention strategy through data driven insights and repeatable risk mitigation plays.

* Operational Excellence & Scalability

* Define and enforce the operating rhythm for the pool, including coverage standards, response expectations, escalation paths, and handoff protocols.

* Ensure documentation discipline so that account context lives in the system, not in individual memory, and any CSM can serve any customer.

* Ensure CRM and CS tooling reflect accurate account health, engagement history, and renewal status.

* Use metrics such as coverage rate, time to first response, adoption, health scores, renewal rates, and expansion ARR to drive performance conversations.

* Identify automation and process improvements that increase capacity without increasing headcount.

* Cross Functional Leadership

* Serve as the voice of a large and diverse customer population internally while balancing business priorities.

* Partner with Support, Product, Professional Services, Renewals, and Sales to improve the customer journey for customers who do not have a dedicated resource.

* Surface systemic risks, adoption blockers, and product feedback trends to senior leadership, using the volume of the pool as an early warning system for the broader base.

* Contribute to strategic planning for the broader Customer Success organization.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS, including:

* 3+ years in Customer Success or account management

* 2+ years managing or leading CSM teams

* Experience operating a pooled, shared, or scaled coverage model, or a demonstrated ability to build one.

* Strong understanding of renewal strategy, retention management, and risk identification at volume.

* Proven ability to design and improve repeatable plays, playbooks, and operating standards.

* Comfort managing through systems and data rather than through individual account relationships.

* Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to translate portfolio signals into prioritized team action.

* A leadership style grounded in transparency, ownership, and high standards.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Customer Success Manager (CSM) to support Veterans Affairs (VA) Data Modernization initiatives. This role plays a critical part in enabling rapid onboarding, improving customer intake processes, and providing high-quality support for users accessing modern data platforms. This position will be fully remote located within the United States.

Responsibilities:

* Own a portfolio of internal customers and build deep relationships across their organizations, from analysts, developers, to directors and above.
* Develop intimate understanding of portfolio customers’ strategic goals, team composition, decision-makers, and targeted business results.
* Collaborate with product, engineering, marketing, and support to realize, track, and report customer values created.
* Collect insights to support identification of scalable user cases that drives platform adoption, maximize customer values, and advocate internally for what teams need to deliver to enable and scale these use cases.
* Maintain rigorous account documentation — success plans, stakeholder maps, risk flags, account pulses, and agreed next steps — that sets the operation context for the broader team.
* Create customer success playbook, customer engagement templates, and team best practices, to leave the customer success function stronger than they found it.
* Serve as the primary “front door” for VA Data Modernization customer support, ensuring a smooth and responsive user experience.
* Provide access and provisioning support, including validating NDS privileges for fast-track users.
* Assist users in understanding cloud data environments, common tools, DevTest data access, and workspace functionality.
* Coordinate with Databricks SMEs and Summit Customer Enablement teams for white-glove support and post‑provisioning engagement.
* Identify blockers and inefficiencies within the intake or support process and escalate improvement opportunities.
* Ensure exceptional customer service by listening to user needs, resolving issues promptly, and providing clear, helpful communication.
* Help workgroups set up their resources and migrate their work loads
* Collaborate with the on-prem teams to decommission the necessary resources after migrations have been completed
* Manage competing priorities, handle research and response for all product line operations related data calls and provide ongoing progress reports.
* Manage parallel projects under a complex program while also providing cross functional program level support.
* Identify and prioritize customers top‑reported and recurring issues to triage them to the appropriate teams and drive them to resolution.

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in an Information Technology, Engineering, or technical discipline (or commensurate experience).
* 8 years of experience in project management or a similar role.
* 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a related field — with a demonstrated track record managing technical products for enterprise accounts and help customers achieve business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to build and navigate relationships across complex organizations, both internally and with customers.
* Proficiency with Building high-quality PowerPoint templates, data analysis with Spreadsheets and Pivot tables, and connecting to databases and building queries.
* Strong troubleshooting, problem‑solving, and analytical abilities.
* Experience supporting user onboarding and access provisioning workflows.
* Excellent communication, customer service, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to document processes clearly and maintain up‑to‑date knowledge articles.

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Experience supporting federal agencies, particularly Veterans Affairs (VA).
* Experience in a high-growth or early-stage company, preferrable in the data analytics and cloud computing space, where you helped create the first playbook and operated with minimum supervision.
* History of contributing to team infrastructure — playbooks, engagement templates, peer coaching, or process improvements that raised overall team performance.
* Proven track record of driving urgent customer requests for the customer and the ability to drive multiple teams toward a common goal.
* Bonus: proficiency with one of more of the following areas: cloud computing basics, data and analytics, SQL, Python.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure with the ability to search for Resource Groups across the SDP and CNG Azure subscriptions
* Ability to provide support in individual Azure resources, including: Launching and supporting Databricks workspaces and assisting in executing and testing queries within the resources
* Ability to guide customers through Azure storage structures.
* Experience processing and troubleshooting change requests, provisioning new resources, removing unused resources, debugging and escalating resource errors, triaging users to gain access to Databricks or other resources

**Clearance Required**

* Ability to obtain and maintain a suitability/Public Trust

Posted Salary Range: USD $135,000.00 - USD $155,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.description:
**About Rippling**

Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.

By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world's top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (#12 out of 500).

**About the role**

Rippling is looking for a customer-obsessed Customer Success Manager (Internally titled: Technical Account Manager (TAM)) to join our rapidly scaling team. As part of our dedicated Customer Success organization, you will work closely with our rapidly scaling and maturing customers to understand their needs, demonstrate where Rippling can solve their problems, and help drive their adoption of Rippling’s product suite. You will own the key admin relationships and be responsible for turning customers into long-term champions, developing account strategy, and enabling Rippling’s customers, all while providing an impeccable customer experience along the way. If you are a self-starter, find yourself constantly taking on new challenges, working diligently until you find solutions, and pride yourself in providing an excellent customer experience, you're in the right place!

The Technical Account Management team manages long-term relationships with Rippling’s growing and complex customers by becoming their trusted Rippling advisor. Our team of 150+ TAMs - spread across the globe - partners cross-functionally from account management to product to engineering and more. Since the TAM team’s inception, we have partnered with hundreds of customers, ensuring their adoption of key Rippling products and success on our platform.  
  
**Please note: We are not currently able to consider or hire any candidates located in the greater San Francisco Bay Area or New York City Metropolitan Area.**

**What you will do**

* **Act as a trusted technical and strategic advisor** by becoming a subject matter expert across Rippling’s entire platform, including complex and regulated fields like payroll, benefits administration, and HR.
* **Provide proactive technical consultation** to help customers optimize their workflows, implement best practices, and increase adoption of new features.
* **Serve as a primary escalation point for critical customer issues**, working cross-functionally with internal Support, Product, and Engineering teams to drive rapid resolution and provide comprehensive root-cause analyses.
* **Build long-term relationships** by owning a book of clients, guiding them through key milestones such as open enrollment and year-end payroll filing.
* **Identify and qualify add-on opportunities** and support renewal negotiations in partnership with your Account Manager counterparts.
* **Master the Rippling product suite** and the nuances of how our offerings work together.
* **Work directly with customers** to understand their core business needs and advise on the most effective Rippling solutions.

**What you will need**

* 3+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role supporting a dedicated book of business at a B2B SaaS company (e.g., Technical Account Manager, Customer Success Manager, Account Manager, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of 40+ accounts and adapt to changing responsibilities.
* Exceptional problem-solving and technical troubleshooting skills.
* Stellar written and verbal communication skills with a track record of building strong customer relationships.
* Hands-on experience resolving complex customer escalations.
* Passion for training both customers and internal teams.

***Bonus points for:***

* Proven subject matter expertise in one or more of the following: HR, Payroll, Benefits Administration, or IT.
* Experience at a technology-focused PEO or HRIS company.
* Experience with a multi-product platform.

To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will independently own a diverse book of Mid-Market and Enterprise customers, while also supporting renewals, escalations, and ad hoc needs across our broader small-to-midmarket customer base. You will serve as a trusted advisor, guiding customers to measurable outcomes, driving adoption of the Fluxx platform, and ensuring long-term retention and growth.

Our Customer Success Team is responsible for managing our customer relationships to ensure mutual benefit. Our role is to work closely with our customers throughout the customer lifecycle to help them maximize their investment in our software and get the most out of the platform. To do this well, the Senior Customer Success Manager (Sr. CSM) will be comfortable communicating across various levels of the customer's organization, backed by an understanding of their business objectives, key priorities, and application usage.

As a trusted advisor and coach, the CSM partners with customers to implement Fluxx's solutions to support their strategic business goals, proactively identifying opportunities for growth and expanded value. **About Versapay \uD83D\uDE80**

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.

Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.

Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.

Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

**How you’ll make a huge impact here - and on your career:**

This is your opportunity to step into a growth-focused role at the intersection of fintech, payments, and customer success. As a Customer Account Manager, you’ll partner with senior finance, accounting, and IT leaders, guiding them through their ongoing digital transformation journey while expanding their use of Versapay’s payments and AR automation solutions. Many of these customers are PE-backed with multi-entity and holding-company structures, so you’ll also build relationships beyond the finance office, with operating partners, managing directors, and portfolio operations leaders at the sponsor or holding-company level. Rather than the traditional hunt, you’ll own and grow a portfolio of existing customers, building long-term relationships, identifying new value opportunities, and collaborating closely with Customer Success Managers to unlock expansion. jobs.description:
**Shape the future of enterprise data orchestration, runtime governance, and AI-driven connectivity.**

Are you a natural relationship builder who loves uncovering customer business challenges and guiding them toward transformative solutions? We are looking for an **Account Manager – Customer Growth** to join our team. In this role, you won't just be reactively fielding incoming requests. You will be the trusted, strategic face of Tavio—working directly with our existing clients to identify new integration opportunities, expand our platform footprint, and guide their transition to the comprehensive Tavio iPaaS platform (including Studio and Hub).

**About Us: The Prerequisite for Agentic AI**

At Tavio, our mission is to eliminate data chaos. But we are not just another lightweight iPaaS. As Artificial Intelligence accelerates how integrations are built and autonomous agents begin executing complex workflows, the true enterprise bottleneck is shifting from connectivity to governance. AI cannot safely execute multi-system workflows without strict, underlying data governance and reliable pipelines.

Tavio provides the secure, structured data rails—the context tier—that Agentic AI requires to operate safely across an enterprise ecosystem. Built on AWS, our next-generation orchestration platform and expert managed services allow tech providers, consultants, and enterprise companies to seamlessly scale critical integrations with embedded policy enforcement. At Tavio, we don't just build connectors: we are building the trusted infrastructure for the future of automated data operations.

**Why You'll Love This Role**

You will be at the absolute forefront of our platform's commercial growth strategy. While our technology solves highly complex workflows for our clients, your job is to be their strategic advisor as they evolve their integration landscape. Backed by a collaborative Sales Engineering, Customer Success, and Product team, you will spend your days learning about our customers' technology environments, mapping out their business goals, and delivering high-value solutions. If you love consultative selling, account strategy, and being a critical driver of revenue in an innovative tech space, you'll fit right in.

**Your Day-to-Day Activities May Include:**

* **Account Growth & Expansion:** Developing account-specific growth plans, identifying platform expansion opportunities, and driving adoption of the broader Tavio iPaaS suite (Studio and Hub).
* **Proactive Customer Discovery:** Conducting regular business and discovery conversations to understand customer tech stacks (ATS, HRIS, ERP, WMS, TMS, etc.), identifying manual integration gaps, and forecasting their integration needs for the next 6–12 months.
* **Stakeholder Mapping:** Building and nurturing relationships beyond primary technical contacts, mapping out business, operational, procurement, and executive stakeholders.
* **iPaaS Conversion:** Strategically prioritizing and converting legacy and Managed Services customers into broader platform users.
* **Opportunity & Pipeline Management:** Qualifying expansion opportunities, coordinating with Sales Engineers for solution demos, building commercial proposals, negotiating agreements, and maintaining accurate forecasts in CRM.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partnering closely with Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Product, and Sales leadership to ensure account alignment and maximum customer value.
* **Customer Retention & Renewals:** Monitoring account health, proactively addressing renewal risks, and securing long-term contract renewals to ensure sustained growth and high satisfaction across key accounts.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, account management, or customer expansion with a proven track record of growing existing account revenue and carrying a target/quota.
* **Consultative Selling:** Strong discovery skills with a natural ability to ask insightful questions and uncover unstated customer needs.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Working understanding of SaaS technology, APIs, integrations, and data movement (experience in iPaaS, HR tech, supply chain, or integration platforms is a major plus).
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Exceptional communication skills with the ability to comfortably engage both technical leads and executive decision-makers.
* **Sales Discipline:** Strong CRM management habits, strategic account planning capabilities, and the grit to thrive in a nimble, fast-growing company.

**Our Core Values:**

* **Stronger Together:** A culture of respect and mutual support.
* **Client Success First:** Delivering real value through adaptable technology.
* **Evolving Partnerships:** Built on transparency and trust.
* **Intentional Efficiency:** Making thoughtful decisions for maximum impact.
