jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Overview:

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.

Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.

As our Customer Success Manager, you will align our goals with those of our clients, maximizing the value we transfer to each other. You will ensure that we understand our clients’ problems and needs, and that they understand and benefit from our software solutions. You will be in the center of a hexagon, moving information among internal and external expert stakeholders: P21 Business Leaders, Product Managers, and Clinical Data Consultants; and also client-side department heads, IT administrators, and end users.

Your challenge is to optimize the tradeoffs between each stakeholder’s respective goals: help P21 renew and expand contracts, communicate product features and user feedback, and meter out limited consulting resources; and also help clients get their preferred fixes and features on our roadmap, navigate the bureaucracy of version upgrades, and train many thousands of people to use our software well.

As the hub of vendor-client intelligence, you will be relied on to guarantee feature adoption and client business success—which should result in customer satisfaction, retention, and revenue growth, as well as direction for our product development efforts. Note: As the market leader, we have almost all the major clients that exist, and the pressure is real. You’ll be doing about four different jobs.

Responsibilities:

**Account Manager: Escort clients along their journey with us.**

* Serve as point of contact starting after initial sale and onboarding clients from their first install (implementation) to expanded use and later version upgrades (adoption).
* Build professional client relationships, facilitating online meetings and offline emails and tickets; follow or create scripts for standard steps in the client journey.
* Move clients through the admin steps surrounding installs and upgrades in tandem with our Implementation Managers and Technical Operations Teams; provide ongoing support for all clients, and extra care for those who are new and/or at-risk. *Note: Some of this extra care involves working beyond or outside of normal hours for clients who have emergencies, operate overseas, or require off-hours system maintenance.*

**Product Evangelist: Educate clients on our features and their intended use.**

* Study our documentation and experiment in our testing environments to learn our selling points, the differences between versions, and the steps for using each feature.
* Route clients through our knowledge libraries to circulate our marketing, training, and informational content, generating excitement and preempting FAQs.
* Represent our Product Managers and Clinical Data Consultants in training users in our intended use cases and supporting their adoption of our advanced features.
* Lure clients onto the latest version of our software by negotiating for their IT resources and articulating our value propositions. *Note: One challenge of your role will be to help clients time their upgrades amidst uncertain or delayed release schedules.*

**Customer Advocate & Communicator: Move key info between clients and our teams.**

* Research each client extensively, writing your findings in our CRM system and triaging which questions we should ask next; facilitate interviews with existing clients biweekly for premium accounts and annually for small pilot accounts.
* Document all discussions with pre-call agenda, post-call notes/minutes, and service desk tickets to track bug reports, feature ideas, or information requests; triage the resulting action steps based on client account size, urgency, and scalability of the solution.
* Escalate or deescalate issues wisely to direct the right staff to the right problem; kindly “remind” your peers to follow through with responses, either in the form of future code changes, temporary workarounds, or the production of more informational content. *Note: Another challenge of your role will be to hear clients’ problems and be able to communicate effectively with other P21 teams who are non-client facing to resolve client needs within timelines specified.*
* Find answers independently by troubleshooting bugs, shadowing our experts, and teaching yourself about our products; remain humble and know when to defer to an expert—which will be most of the time at first.

**Business Analyst: Ask good questions and listen to clients’ pain points.**

* Drive client satisfaction by tracking both stories and stats that show account health.
* Gather qualitative intel from direct observation of client environments and anecdotal evidence from routine interviews, e.g., pain points, nuances in their use cases, feedback on features, and opportunities for more training. *Note: We often go off script for our largest clients in helping them resolve emergencies, so it will be a challenge to promote long-term health while dealing with the short-term “crisis of the week.”*
* Gather quantitative intel from analysis of client click paths and usage metrics to identify patterns of (mis)use, interpreting these insights in light of their stories.
* Identify gaps and overlaps between clients’ existing processes and our intended use cases to advise their scope and sequence in adopting our solutions.

jobs.title: Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Health Coach
jobs.description:
Cadence is the clinical AI company automating the treatment of chronic disease. Its Clinical Intelligence takes on the routine, high-volume work of chronic care – monitoring patients, surfacing risks, and coordinating action – so clinicians can focus on the decisions that require them. Grounded in partnerships with more than 20 leading health systems, deep EMR integrations, dedicated medical group, and experience serving a population of more than 100,000 patients, the system learns from real-world care delivery, improving as it scales. Cadence has been recognized by TIME as one of the Top 100 HealthTech Companies and by LinkedIn as a Top Startup (#4, 2025).

**The Role**

We’re hiring a Bilingual/Spanish Speaking Clinical Navigator (Health Coach) to deliver virtual chronic care support for Medicare patients enrolled in Cadence care programs.

Clinical Navigators deliver proactive, patient-centered outreach and follow-through. Depending on program needs, this role includes structured patient check-ins, coaching and goal-setting, care coordination to close gaps in care, and addressing barriers such as access to resources, transportation, or medication refills. Clinical Navigators document patient interactions in the Cadence platform and collaborate closely with the clinical team to escalate concerns and coordinate next steps, ensuring patients feel supported, informed, and engaged throughout their care journey.

**Schedule**

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States. Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, with the following schedule options:

* **Central, Mountain, Arizona, or Pacific Time:** 8am to 5pm or 9am to 6pm
* **Eastern Time:** 9am to 6pm ET only

**What You’ll Do**

* Conduct outbound telephonic patient outreach and provide one-on-one coaching and support to patients managing chronic conditions, including but not limited to type 2 diabetes, hypertension, and cardiovascular disease.
* Help patients execute personalized care plans and achieve their goals by providing education and coaching focused on behavior modification, nutrition, physical activity, and self-management strategies using evidence-based techniques such as motivational interviewing and SMART goals.
* Conduct comprehensive assessments of patients' health status, lifestyle behaviors, nutritional habits, and readiness to change.
* Educate patients on disease management, medication adherence, symptom recognition, and prevention strategies, and execute care delivery tasks in accordance with Cadence clinical policies and established protocols, under appropriate clinical supervision.
* Monitor patients' progress, adherence to treatment plans, and health outcomes through regular check-ins and remote monitoring tools.
* Document patient interactions, outcomes, and follow-up plans in the Cadence platform; identify barriers to care (including social needs) and connect patients with resources or internal support pathways.
* Collaborate in real time with clinicians and patient support teams using tools such as our Cadence Platform, Google Workspace, and Slack, and contribute feedback to improve workflows in a fast-moving, change-oriented environment.

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification. Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

**Who You Are**

* A clinician who thrives at the intersection of rigorous care standards and a care delivery model that is still being built.
* Skilled in patient education, coaching, and care coordination - you meet patients where they are in life, considering their age, lifestyle, and diet.
* Disciplined in documentation and follow-through, with the attention to detail required for accurate clinical records in a remote environment.
* Reliable and consistent in schedule adherence, with the interpersonal communication skills to build trust with patients over the phone.
* Comfortable working independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with evolving workflows, and tech-savvy enough to navigate and troubleshoot multiple systems simultaneously while keeping patients engaged.
* Comfortable using AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini or Open Evidence) to support patient interactions and surface relevant clinical context, while maintaining clinical judgment as the primary guide for every patient decision.
* Biased toward action - you bring clinical authority to every interaction, make the call when it counts, and take ownership of outcomes.

**What You Need**

* An active NBHWC health coaching certification is required.
* At least 1 year of experience as a health coach is required.
* Experience providing patient education and support to individuals managing chronic conditions is required.
* Remote work readiness (including stable high-speed WiFi) is required.
* Fluency in Spanish is required.
* Fluency with AI-assisted clinical tools (such as Gemini, Open Evidence, or comparable platforms) and the ability to speak credibly with providers and patients about where AI supports care delivery and where human judgment remains non-negotiable.

**Compensation**

The anticipated salary range for this role is $22 - $26 per hour, which is based on role scope, level, and location. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for incentive compensation as part of the overall total rewards package. This position is remote and based in the United States. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, internal equity, and applicable law.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Competitive pay & equity\*
* Fully remote
* Comprehensive health coverage: Medical, dental & vision
* Paid time off
* 401k plan + matching
* Paid parental leave
* Home office stipend

* benefit offerings may vary depending on job prof

Senior Tax Strategy Implementation Specialist  
**Holistic Tax Advisors | Fully Remote | Independent Contractor Opportunity**

Holistic Tax Advisors seeks an experienced tax professional to execute approved tax strategies for individuals and business owners.

**This is an implementation engagement. It does not include leading client advisory calls, managing client relationships, selling services, or independently developing and approving tax plans.**

Our advisory team owns strategy recommendations and client communication. You will own the assigned implementation work, from reviewing the approved plan through completing required actions, verifying supporting records, and delivering an organized handoff to the tax preparation team.

The engagement requires strong technical knowledge and proven hands-on execution experience. You must understand how strategies work in practice, recognize implementation problems, and know when to escalate an issue.  
Scope and Deliverables

* Convert approved strategies into implementation plans identifying prerequisites, tasks, responsible parties, deadlines, and completion requirements.
* Review client information for completeness and consistency; flag facts that may affect implementation.
* Prepare implementation forms, schedules, instructions, and supporting records within the agreed scope and your professional qualifications.
* Coordinate required actions with the firm’s advisory and preparation teams, bookkeepers, payroll providers, attorneys, financial professionals, and other providers.
* Give the client-facing team precise requests for documents, signatures, information, and client actions.
* Maintain accurate implementation records and written updates identifying completed work, outstanding dependencies, and issues requiring a decision.
* Verify required actions and supporting evidence before marking work complete.
* Deliver a documented handoff explaining what was implemented, relevant amounts and dates, outstanding items, and information needed for tax preparation.
* Identify opportunities to improve implementation workflows and documentation.

If client facts conflict with the approved plan or a technical question requires a new advisory decision, pause the affected work and escalate it to the advisor.

**Experience and Qualifications**  
We are targeting professionals with:

* Five or more years of relevant U.S. tax experience, including at least three years personally implementing tax strategies. Equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered.
* Proven execution experience with the strategy categories relevant to the assigned work, such as entity and election implementation, owner and family payroll, accountable plans, retirement-plan coordination, or real estate strategy implementation.
* Working knowledge of implementation requirements, substantiation, deadlines, and the connection between completed actions and tax return reporting.
* Experience coordinating multiple parties and managing implementation dependencies.
* Strong research, documentation, quality review, and written communication skills.
* Ability to deliver technically sound work independently within an agreed scope.

EA or CPA credentials are preferred. Credentials and job titles support, but do not replace, demonstrated implementation experience.

**AI and Automation**  
You should be comfortable using approved AI tools, workflow automation, and document systems to improve execution.

You must be able to:

* Review generated documents, calculations, and research for accuracy and applicability.
* Verify material tax conclusions against appropriate authority.
* Identify missing facts, unsupported assumptions, and incorrect outputs.
* Keep automated actions within the authorized scope and required approval checkpoints.
* Protect client information and use only approved systems for confidential data.
* Maintain records of material actions and human review.

You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of your deliverables.

**Remote Working Requirements**  
This engagement is fully remote. It requires a secure workspace, reliable connectivity, effective written collaboration, and compliance with the firm’s data security requirements.  
Scope, fees, deliverables, deadlines, coordination expectations, and acceptance criteria will be established in a written services agreement.

**Selection Process**  
Applicants should provide three examples of strategies they personally implemented, clearly distinguishing their work from work completed by others.

Finalists will complete a practical exercise using a fictional client scenario and discuss their approach, technical decisions, and completion evidence. Relevant employment history, credentials, and implementation experience will be verified, including through a reference who directly reviewed or supervised the work.

Do not submit confidential client information or proprietary employer materials.

Pay: $35.00 - $50.00 per hour

Expected hours: 25.0 per week

* Provide three examples of strategies you have personally implemented, clearly distinguishing your work from work completed by others.

We are hiring a part-time Sales & Operations Leader to run the sales and operations staff across three businesses: BICS (IT and analytics consulting), Evolve (digital marketing), and S&N Investment Properties (real estate). The people doing the work are already in place; this Leader keeps them on process, verifies execution, and drives revenue, close rate, and customer engagement heading into 2027.

**Job responsibilities**

· **Strategic execution:** Translate founder and leadership ideas into a defined objective, owner, next step, timeline, and practical measure of progress. Surface tradeoffs when priorities change.

· **Sales leadership and revenue operations:** Review HubSpot visibility, opportunity ownership, follow-up and stalled deals. Join selected sales calls to observe performance, give specific feedback, coach the sales team, and improve discovery and handoffs. The assigned salesperson remains accountable for the call and follow-up.

· **Marketing and outreach:** Drive marketing and outreach to existing BICS and Evolve clients and selected prospects. With no dedicated marketing team, define the audience, offer, message, channels and next steps; personally build or coordinate the materials and campaigns; and assess what generates useful conversations.

· **RFP and proposal leadership:** Review RFPs for fit, requirements, credibility and quality. Serve as the point person gathering relevant project examples, results, references, technical input and other source material from delivery and leadership so proposals are sufficiently supported. Coordinate revisions with the proposal writer and pursuit owner.

· **Cross-company coordination:** Connect people and decisions across BICS and Evolve when an initiative spans sales, marketing, delivery, finance, or administration. Identify work without a clear owner.

· **Onboarding and handoffs:** Coordinate the operational pieces of new team member and client onboarding, including access, documentation, role expectations and handoffs to the assigned owners. Confirm that outstanding setup steps have an owner and are completed.

· **Operational blocker resolution:** Act as the liaison among administrative, accounting, IT and other support staff to identify and resolve blockers. Bring the founder a concise decision or escalation when the issue exceeds the role’s authority or available resources.

· **Client engagement:** Maintain direct contact with clients when an introduction, relationship check-in, service concern, expansion conversation or cross-team coordination would help move work forward. Bring the appropriate sales or delivery owner into follow-up.

· **Operational improvement:** Assess workflows, staffing arrangements, tools, AI, and automation opportunities. Move approved changes into use with an owner, basic validation, and follow-through.

· **Delivery and PM enablement:** Partner with delivery leadership to strengthen handoffs, project visibility, and practical PM standards without creating a large training burden. Delivery leadership retains project and PM management.

**Required traits and skills**

· **Hands on:** Willing and able to do the work, learn unfamiliar technology, and build new tools or solutions when the business needs them.

· **Comfort with ambiguity:** Works from incomplete context, asks targeted questions, checks assumptions, and brings back a concrete recommendation rather than waiting for a complete brief.

· **Independent judgment and resilience:** Makes practical decisions with incomplete information, explains the reasoning, and remains steady when feedback changes the direction. Adjusts and keeps work moving without relying on the founder for every next step.

· **Commercial and technical fluency:** Understands a small technology services firm well enough to connect client needs, delivery capacity, proposals, CRM activity, and profitability. Deep engineering expertise is unnecessary.

· **Independent follow-through:** Tracks commitments, closes loops across contractors and teams, escalates blockers early, and adapts when circumstances change.

· **Pragmatic systems judgment:** Uses lightweight routines and selective automation to improve reliability without imposing unnecessary meetings, documentation, or software.

Expected hours: 15.0 – 20.0 per week

The Graduate Funding Unit plays a central role in maintaining the highest level of academic excellence possible at UC Berkeley. new_jobs.title: Fire Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Fire Project Manager**

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help improve the performance of buildings to serve people, places, and the planet. Here, you will join a collaborative team with opportunities to grow through meaningful work, learning, and hands-on project experience.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As a Fire Project Manager, you will lead fire alarm, security, and communications installation projects from planning through closeout. You will help ensure work is delivered safely, on schedule, within scope, and with strong attention to customer satisfaction, quality, and financial performance across commercial, educational, healthcare, industrial, and military environments.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead fire alarm, security, and communications installation projects through all phases of execution.
* Establish local project offices and coordinate scope, risk, methodology, and resource planning.
* Manage schedules, costs, safety, quality, and customer expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
* Coordinate work from design and permitting through material delivery, labor scheduling, and field installation.
* Facilitate Work in Progress meetings, status reviews, and issue resolution with internal teams and customers.
* Support change order processing and look for opportunities to improve project margin.
* Ensure projects are completed in alignment with company standards, customer requirements, published codes, standards, unique specifications, and AHJ requirements.

**How You Will Do It**
----------------------

* Own project outcomes with accountability, safety, and integrity while keeping customer commitments in focus.
* Stay close to the work by coordinating design, permits, delivery, labor, and installation details so obstacles are identified and removed early.
* Use a disciplined project plan to track schedule, budget, quality, and risk, and communicate progress clearly to stakeholders.
* Improve every day by applying codes, standards, unique specifications, and AHJ requirements with candor and practical problem-solving.
* Win as one team by working across field, office, and customer partners to resolve issues, manage change orders, and deliver strong results.
* Follow departmental and SOX procedures and maintain accurate project documentation from start to finish.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 5 years of installation experience in Fire, Electrical, or Security systems.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification to be obtained within two years of employment.
* NICET Level II to be obtained within one year of employment.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications, including Excel and Project.
* Ability to create Excel spreadsheets, reference data across spreadsheets, and create macros.
* Availability for frequent local travel.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Certificate or diploma in Fire & Life Safety, Electrical/Electronic, or Security.
* Certification in Fire Alarm Systems.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

We offer a competitive salary and bonus plan, with a hiring range of $98,200-$135,000 based on experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. You will also be eligible for a comprehensive benefits package including 401K, medical, dental, and vision care available day one. Additional support includes paid vacation, holidays, and sick time, extensive product and on-the-job cross-training opportunities, a collaborative environment, a company vehicle, and our Zero Harm commitment to safety.

If you are ready to lead important projects and make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

* 4+ years of experience in program management, project management, operations, technology programs, data programs, or a related field.

* Demonstrated experience independently leading complex, cross-functional programs.

* Experience managing multiple workstreams, dependencies, stakeholders, and external partners.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including communication with senior stakeholders.

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing AI, data, software, or technology programs.

* Experience managing strategic vendors or external data providers.

* Experience establishing program governance, operating mechanisms, or standardized processes.

**The application window is expected to close on:** 10/29/2026
  
Meet the Team
  
  
Product Operations Central (Process and Business Intelligence) is a core component of the Product Operations team, providing a centralized hub of multi-disciplinary expertise that fortifies the strategic and operational framework for Business Units (BUs) across Cisco’s product portfolio. This team acts as a strategic partner, collaborating with cross-functional leaders to define Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) strategies, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation across NPI, sustaining, and end-to-end supply chain processes.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
In this role, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our future by proactively collaborating with peers, senior leaders, and functional SMEs. You will bridge the gap between complex PLM business processes and advanced data-driven insights. By implementing innovative analytical solutions, you will ensure our operational framework is both scalable and highly effective.
  
  
As part of this role, you will drive the strategic vision for Business Intelligence (BI) by leading the strategy and execution of initiatives that improve process improvement and foster data-driven decision-making across the product portfolio. You will lead and influence cross-functional collaboration by orchestrating efforts among Product Operations, Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO), Technology& Quality (T), and Engineering teams, unifying these groups under shared data objectives. Your expertise in sophisticated analytics and data integrity will be critical as you define and automate quality frameworks to ensure high-fidelity data, performing deep-dive analyses into product health, development velocity, and operational KPIs.
  
Leveraging Google Cloud Platform (GCP) tools such as BigQuery and Cloud Composer, you will enable scalable data processing and utilize Google Workspace for collaborative policy management and cross-functional project tracking. You will also play a key role in risk management and mitigation by navigating operational risks through collaborative engagement and developing data-backed mitigation strategies integrated into our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) business processes.
  
  
Operational optimization is another core responsibility, where you will use design-thinking sessions within our business sensing framework to understand business unit challenges and ensure analytical solutions are perfectly aligned with business goals.
  
  
This role drives significant business impact by aligning the organization toward a unified, data-driven PLM strategy that accelerates velocity across New Product Introduction (NPI) and sustaining phases. It harnesses scalable intelligence through GCP infrastructure to transform large datasets into real-time operational insights, improves operational efficiency by automating data quality and BI solutions to reduce manual processes, and supports risk mitigation by equipping leadership with analytical tools to identify and address supply chain and product lifecycle risks proactively.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Information Systems, or related field.
* 7+ years of experience in PLM, NPI/Sustaining, HW development, and end-to-end supply chain engineering.
* 5 + years of program management experience leading cross functional teams in complex environments with layered dependencies.
* Expert proficiency in SQL, Tableau, or Power BI.
* Proven experience with Google Cloud platform or similar for data visualization.

Preferred skills
  
  

* Experience in Python or R for advanced statistical analysis.
* Familiarity with Data Governance/Quality tools (e.g., Alation, Big Eye, Monte Carlo).
* Ability to articulate complex data-driven strategies and gain consensus at the executive level.
* Familiarity with AI/ML applications and automation to enhance supply chain/product development.
* Strong commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About this Opportunity:**  
At Regency Centers, our people are our greatest asset, and we believe that our highly skilled and talented team makes us better. We are seeking a full-time Project Manager (Construction) to join our regional office located in Walnut Creek, California. The Project Manager leads construction across an assigned portfolio of existing shopping centers, with a primary focus on tenant improvements, landlord work, redevelopment, space reconfigurations, and property capital improvements. They manage budgets, schedules, consultants, and contractors from scope development and design through permitting, construction, tenant turnover, and closeout. This position works closely with Leasing, Property Management, Tenant Coordination, and Development Accounting to meet lease obligations and operating needs while coordinating work around existing tenants and customers. The Project Manager handles multiple concurrent projects and may support major ground-up developments as assigned.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**  

* Manage construction at existing shopping centers, including landlord work, tenant improvements, white box work, vacant space preparation, space divisions, redevelopment, and facade renovations. Ensure delivery is on time, on budget, and consistent with lease, design, and brand standards.
* Assist with ground up development projects.
* Collaborate with Leasing, Tenant Coordination, Property Management, and Legal to define landlord delivery obligations, evaluate scopes of work, and align lease language and construction exhibits. Coordinate landlord work with tenant delivery requirements.
* Lead budgeting and scheduling for tenant, redevelopment, and property construction projects, including estimates for landlord lease obligations and capital improvements. Monitor and forecast costs, address risks, and track deviations from plan.
* Oversee the preparation and execution of construction contracts and change orders in partnership with Contract Administration. Ensure contractor performance, insurance compliance, and lien waiver documentation.
* Manage existing condition assessments, design, permitting, and utility coordination for tenant work, redevelopment, and property improvements. Evaluate constructability, support entitlement approvals when needed, and plan construction phasing to limit disruption to tenants and customers.
* Manage assigned property capital improvements in coordination with Property Management, including roof replacements, parking lot reconstruction, facade work, HVAC replacements, and major site or building system upgrades.
* Track project milestones, landlord completion dates, and closeout requirements. Maintain project reporting tools and internal dashboards, and provide regular updates to construction leadership, Property Management, Tenant Coordination, and Accounting.

Are You Qualified?
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Construction Engineering, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or related field
* Minimum five (5) years of retail or commercial construction management experience, to include supervisory experience
* Ability to travel regionally & frequently visit all assigned construction sites
* Ability to work varying and flexible hours as needed for tenant delivery, construction in operating shopping centers, and public meetings
* Experience with tenant improvements, redevelopment, and construction in operating shopping centers preferred
* Knowledge of retail construction, tenant improvements, redevelopment, existing building systems, and permitting
* Skilled in reviewing documents for conformity to standards of Regency jurisdictions and/or tenants
* Ability to comprehend architectural and engineering drawings and complex legal documents
* Proficiency with personal computers and MS Office, MS Excel, MS Project, Zoom, & JD Edwards software
* Skilled in analyzing construction costs for landlord lease obligations, tenant improvements, redevelopment, and property capital projects and recommending budgetary adjustments as appropriate
* Regency Centers will not sponsor employment-based immigration petitions or applications for this position, including but not limited to H-1B, TN visa, or permanent residency.

**Personal Traits We Value:**  

* Project management skills (planning, organizing, informing, directing others)
* Decisiveness, problem-solving, time-management, multi-tasking and presentation skills
* Communication skills (interpersonal savvy, customer focus, oral and written communication)
* Trust and integrity
* Negotiation and conflict resolution skills
* Ability to work within a team environment

**A Little Bit About Us:**  
We own and operate premier shopping centers in suburban neighborhoods in the top cities and markets across the country. We live by a strong set of values, which have guided us for more than 60 years.
  
  
Our centers thrive with highly productive grocers, restaurants, service providers, and terrific retailers that connect to their communities and customers. We are also active developers of new shopping centers that feature great merchandising, placemaking, and customer engagement as part of our Fresh Look™ program.
  
  
We are a vertically integrated real estate company and a qualified real estate investment trust (REIT) that is self-administered, self-managed, and an S&P 500 Index member. Learn more about us at RegencyCenters.com.
  
  
**Benefits:**  
Our compensation and benefits package is very competitive and includes the following benefits and more. For additional information visit www.regencycenters.com/careers.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  

* 23+ PTO days annually
* 11 paid holidays (in addition to PTO)
* Paid leave programs (parental, compassion, bereavement, jury duty, and military)
* Health Advocacy + Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Financial Security
  

* 401(k) with a generous company match plus corporate profit sharing
* Anniversary stock grant awards
* Health Savings Account

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Product Immersion & Testing
new_jobs.description:
Meta is building the future of human connection through technology. Our family of apps and services connects billions of people worldwide, empowering them to share what matters most and bringing people closer together. Central to our mission is ensuring our products meet the highest standards of quality and user satisfaction.The Product Immersion & Testing Team within Business Product Marketing (BPM) is seeking a Program Manager who is passionate about customer insights, testing, launching, and scaling Meta's newest business and marketing solutions. We accelerate business growth and product development by integrating the voice of the customer into our product marketing flywheel, leveraging insights to drive impactful strategies and outcomes.As an ideal candidate, you have experience navigating ambiguity, defining project scope independently, and aligning stakeholders around a clear plan of action. You have a proven track record of managing complex projects, collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Data Science, Product Marketing, and leveraging customer insights and data analysis to inform decisions. You have deep experience with Meta's business tools (e.g., Ads Manager), marketing, and measurement, and you have experience distilling complex ideas into actionable insights.  
  
  

### **Program Manager, Product Immersion & Testing Responsibilities:**

* Lead Product Immersion & Testing Initiatives: Manage, monitor, and recruit for product tests (alpha, beta, GA) and immersions, driving delivery of multiple projects as the main point of contact for Product, Sales, and Data Science
* Planning and Strategy: Define goals, identify clients, coordinate logistics, and compile key information into briefs for immersion and testing projects
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work extensively with Product Managers, Product Marketing, Data Science, Engineering, and User Research to scope immersion and test design/requirements, manage logistics, and surface insights to influence for product and business outcomes (product changes, roadmap impact)
* Communication: Effectively communicate relevant insights and findings to cross-functional teams, influencing roadmap prioritization and developing solutions to fix problems at scale
* Process Improvement: Inform, influence, and execute new processes based on analysis and impact metrics to improve efficiency and quality of support
* Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and problem-solve issues (bugs, feature requests, product confusions) during testing and immersions, utilizing escalation paths and updating stakeholders
* Travel: Support in-market experiences, with up to 20% travel (including international)

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree in a relevant field (e.g., Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field)
* 4+ years' experience in program/project management, customer service, marketing, user/UX research, operations, or product testing
* 4+ years' experience managing, tracking, and measuring digital marketing campaigns
* Experience initiating and driving projects to completion with minimal guidance
* Experience building relationships with cross-functional teams, delivering impact through communication and influence
* Experience implementing processes/programs to improve product or team performance
* Confidence working independently and leading cross-functional teams
* Understanding of product development, market research, and testing principles
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills
* Experience with internal project management tools and escalation paths

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Comfortable dealing with high-pressure, fast-moving, and ambiguous problems
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience with Ads Manager and/or other Meta ad platform interfaces
* Experience working with a broad range of customers or user segments
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience with A/B testing
* Experience contributing at both strategic and operational levels

  
  
  

### **About Meta:**

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

new_jobs.title: Product Risk Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll sit at the intersection of product, legal, and regulations — triaging and supporting risk review for new products and features that challenge company policy, introduce novel or untested risk, or require specialized scrutiny.Your work will shape how Meta assesses high-risk product decisions, often in fast-moving or ambiguous contexts. You’ll help guide cross-functional partners through escalation workflows, support aligned decision-making, and ensure that the right voices are in the room to evaluate complex tradeoffs. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence—bringing a broad perspective to problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to team-level goals for cross-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment and the ability to work across a range of variable, often ambiguous risk factors.This is a senior individual-contributor role. Success means managing and delivering programs for a loosely defined area of work, aligning solutions across teams, and advising cross-functional partners as a subject-matter expert on complex matters in your area.  
  
  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Support and manage the triage and escalation process for product risks that are novel, ambiguous, or policy-challenging.
* Coordinate across Legal, Policy, Data Strategy, Engineering, and Product to ensure high-risk reviews are surfaced and addressed with the appropriate depth and speed
* network with and appropriately involve key stakeholders, persuading diverse audiences to drive progress.
* Translate complex technical and product concepts into structured assessments and recommendations.
* Facilitate decision-making through risk-based frameworks that support both product velocity and compliance
* seek clarity on goals and priorities so work can move forward quickly, and escalate as needed.
* Ensure escalations are documented, tracked, and resolved with transparency and consistency, maintaining appropriate documentation and timely follow-through.
* Identify gaps or breakdowns in current escalation/review processes and drive improvements in workflows, guidance, or tooling
* actively experiment and seek opportunities to simplify work through AI-integrated workflows.
* Help Meta meet its legal and regulatory obligations and make decisions that reflect our mission, values, and principles, informed by risk reviews and compliance guidance.

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust & safety, privacy, compliance or in a related field
* Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver high-pressure, high-ambiguity projects involving dependencies across multiple stakeholders, teams, or functions
* Experience assessing and triaging novel or ambiguous product risks, particularly where no established policy, process, or precedent exists
* Strong communication and cross-functional alignment skills — especially in navigating sensitive tradeoffs
* Familiarity with data flows, technical systems, and/or understanding of product risks and their applicable mitigations
* Track record of influencing decisions and driving progress without formal authority
* Experience building, improving, or operationalizing risk review, escalation, assessment, or governance processes
* Strong judgment in situations involving competing priorities, incomplete information, and significant business, regulatory, safety, privacy, or reputational risk
* Experience using AI/automation to improve complex workflows, analysis, decision-making, or operational processes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort embracing ambiguity and improving systems
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
* Experience applying analytical and problem-solving skills to improve processes or resolve complex issues
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
* Experience in managing cross-functional projects and teams
* Experience in leveraging AI and data-driven insights to continuously improve the efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of a process

**Title:** **Case** **Management** **Program** **Manager**

**Classification**: **Full-time, Exempt**

**Reports** **to:** **Chief of Staff**

**Supervises:** **Case Managers and Patient Navigators**

**Annual Salary $80,000-$95,000**

ABOUT RITTER CENTER:

For over 40 years, Ritter Center has worked to prevent and resolve homelessness and improve the health, dignity, and well-being of people living in poverty in Marin.

When you join Ritter Center, you join a highly trained staff that combines national clinical best practices with a whole-person care approach to solving each person’s medical and mental health, housing, and food needs.

We are growing to meet the needs of our community. We are looking for staff who are ready for a career with a mission-driven organization, want to be valued, have diverse experience, and have compassion. If this sounds like you, we would love to have you join us!

**All positions at Ritter Center require a background check and Livescan fingerprinting.**

**Please visit our jobs page on our** **website** **for a complete list of our employee benefits.**  
  
Ritter Center is currently recruiting for a Program Manager for our Case Management Department. This full-time, exempt position reports to the Chief of Staff based in San Rafael, CA; the role ***operates out of our main Campus.***

The Case Management Program Manager is an integral role in Ritter Center’s dynamic multidisciplinary team of medical, behavioral health and case management professionals who provide integrated care to our target population. This position reports directly to the Chief of Staff and supervises a team of 7 employees comprised of 3 Case Managers and 3 Patient Navigators and 1 Admin Coordinator. The Program Manager also provides a limited amount of direct client services while managing the work of the team. The services are: Representative Payee, Patient Navigation, Rapid Rehousing funds, Housing First (HBCM), and Custody to Community. This position also serves as the Agency Lead for the Homeless Management Information System (HMIS) to ensure timely and accurate data entry across all agency HMIS users. This role leads efforts to triage all drop-in case management and referral services and oversees the coordination of overall client flow.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Recruit, hire, train and supervise a team of Case Managers and Patient Navigators providing trauma-informed care across a comprehensive and diverse range of programs to ensure effective services and outcomes.
* Conduct regular team meetings and individual supervision sessions.
* Oversee the day-to-day operations, service quality, and client flow of Case Management programs while ensuring compliance with all legal, regulatory, contractual, and funding requirements.
* Meet regularly with Chief of Staff and attend staff meetings and training as scheduled.
* Function as a part of a multidisciplinary team to support the engagement and services for chronically homeless individuals and families with severe and persistent mental illness, physical disabilities, and/or substance use.
* Collaborate with Accounting to verify compliance and accurate tracking of Housing First rental subsidy payments, Rapid Rehousing payments, Rental Assistance payments, Representative Payee accounts management and Social Security reporting.
* Attend and represent Ritter Center at all required County level case conferencing, advocacy, and policy meetings as well as community events and media appearances when requested.
* Oversee accurate record-keeping, documentation, reporting, and retention of client and program records within HMIS and other organizational systems.
* Partner with the Clinical staff to ensure integration of clinical services.
* Supervise and provide strategic direction for case management staff, including leading meetings, performance evaluations, and professional coaching.
* Ensure effective onboarding, performance management, and policy adherence of staff supervised.
* Maintain high staff morale to enable a positive and inclusive culture.
* Work collaboratively to enhance service integration within the organization and non-profit community partners throughout Marin County.
* Serve as a member of the leadership team. Contribute to the development of and adhere to Ritter Center’s goals, objectives, policies and procedures.
* Support Quality Improvement (QI) activities; collect, analyze and report data regarding client services according to all case management contracts as well as organizational-wide QI measures.
* Collaborate closely with Marin County Continuum of Care (CoC) partner Community Based Organizations (CBO), and other Social Service agencies to ensure appropriate support and referrals are being made by the team.
* Oversee resolution of complex service challenges and guide staff in developing effective approaches and solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Per our Federally Qualified Healthcare Center (FQHC) requirements employment at Ritter Center requires compliance with being able to produce a negative TB test prior to the start of employment, as well as being vaccinated against COVID-19 (unless applying for an exemption) per the August 5, 2020 State Public Order for Healthcare Facilities, providers and employees.
* Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Social Work, Counseling, Criminal Justice, or another behavioral or social science field.
* Equivalent experience (2+ years) in benefits administration, Representative Payee services, case management, or a closely related field. Additional experience may be substituted for a degree.
* Experience with social services in Marin County is highly preferred.
* Prior management experience in a social services setting, including employee supervision, implementation of new service models, program management, and ensuring compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
* Familiarity with budgeting and accounting practices is highly preferred.

new_jobs.title: Stonestown- ASP Program Leader
new_jobs.description:
**Careers by** **E****mpowering Futures, Building Communities**

Imagine going to work each day knowing that your efforts positively impact individuals and communities. As a global movement and the nation's leading nonprofit organization dedicated to strengthening communities through youth development, healthy living, and social responsibility, the YMCA of Greater San Francisco offers more than just a job—we offer a career with a future and the opportunity to make a lasting difference in your community. At the Y, you can uncover your passion and build a lifelong career addressing some of the nation's most pressing social issues.

**Our Organizational Culture**

At the YMCA of Greater San Francisco, we are committed to demonstrating values that aim to building strong communities where you can **Be**, **Belong** and **Become.** With **Truth & Courage**, we strive to understand and act on individual and societal truths. We ensure a safe and inclusive environment with **Authenticity & Accessibility**, allowing everyone to participate according to their needs. Our approach is **Dependable & Creative**, as we respond to community needs through strong partnerships. Above all, we embody **Dignity & Empathy**, treating everyone with respect and compassion, and recognizing the inherent dignity in all individuals.

**Qualifications**  

* 18+ for elementary programs; 21+ for middle school programs.
* Associate’s degree or higher, or High School diploma/equivalent with one of the following:

o 48+ completed college units (verified by transcript),  
o Passing score on the CA Basic Education Skills Test (CBEST), or  
o Passing score on a District Instructional Aide Exam.  

* Strong teamwork and communication skills.
* Knowledge of youth development principles.
* Available Monday–Friday during program hours
* TB Test clearance within last 2 years (required for programs on school district sites).

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in child development or related field OR equivalent professional and community experience.
* Experience working with elementary or middle school-aged youth.
* Bilingual skills in Spanish, Cantonese, Mandarin, or other languages.
* Knowledge of arts, dance, drama, sports, or other enrichment areas.

**Position Summary**

The After School Program Leader provides meaningful opportunities for youth in YMCA programs at local elementary and middle schools. They work under the supervision of Program Site Coordinators and Directors and are expected to demonstrate flexibility, initiative, and punctuality, with a commitment to the school-year schedule.

  

After School Program Dates

* San Francisco Sites: August 10, 2026 – June 2, 2027
* Marin Sites: August 17, 2026 – June 11, 2027

**Job Responsibilities**

  

**Curriculum Development & Program Delivery**

* Design and implement engaging, inclusive, and theme-based curricula that reflect the developmental stages and cultural backgrounds of youth.
* Facilitate academic enrichment, tutoring, and structured outdoor recreational activities.
* Partner with staff, caregivers, and participants to plan and enhance program offerings.  
  **Supervision & Safety**
* Supervise groups of up to 20 students, ensuring a safe, supportive, and inclusive environment in alignment with YMCA and child safety protocols.
* Actively monitor participants, respond promptly to incidents, and consistently apply safety guideline  
  **Record-Keeping & Compliance**
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records, including attendance, emergency information, and safety documentation  
  **Communication & Engagement**
* Communicate clearly and respectfully with participants, caregivers, staff, and volunteers to support a positive program experience.  
  **Training & Development**
* Complete required safety and program training before the first shift and attend all mandatory meetings and training sessions.

  

**Work Environment & Physical Demands**

The After School Program Leader works in a dynamic environment at local elementary or middle school sites, including indoor classrooms and outdoor schoolyards. The role involves frequent standing, walking, and active participation in physical activities such as recreational sports and games. The environment can be fast-paced and loud, and the role may require occasional lifting of up to 20 pounds.

  

**Disclaimers**

* Must successfully complete a background screening, including criminal and employment verification. Some positions may also require a credit check.

* All duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA of Greater San Francisco promotes an equal employment opportunity workplace, which includes reasonable accommodation for otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please contact your manager if you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

* This job description may not be all-inclusive, and employees are expected to perform other duties as assigned by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified by management as needed.

* Strong problem-solving skills, and ability to be flexible and adaptive to change.

new_jobs.title: Temporary Assistant Farmers Market Manager-Clement St
new_jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY**

The Agricultural Institute of Marin is seeking a **temporary part-time Assistant Farmers Market Manager** for our year-round farmers market that occurs every Sunday on Clement St in San Francisco from **October 25 - December 20****.** The Assistant Farmers Market Manager assures the smooth operation of the farmers market by assisting the Market Manager in setup and breakdown of the market and by providing excellent customer service in the Information Booth. This is an entry-level position with potential for a career pathway in farmers markets operations, agricultural education, or local food systems strategies.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Assist the Market Manager with all aspects of market operations, including securing the site and overseeing market setup and breakdown.

* Set up, maintain, and break down market equipment, including ATM(s), signage, information booth, restrooms, entertainment areas, café seating, and waste diversion stations (recycling, compost, and garbage).

* Staff the information booth, providing excellent customer service and processing customer transactions.

* Operate AIM's EBT program, including processing EBT transactions and distributing tokens for eligible food purchases.

* Foster positive relationships with vendors, customers, staff, community organizations, local businesses, and government representatives.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Must be at least 21 years of age.

* Valid California driver's license with a clean driving record.

* Ability to lift and move up to 50 lbs. repeatedly and load/unload equipment from a truck.

* Strong communication, organizational, problem-solving, and multitasking skills with exceptional attention to detail.

* Ability to remain calm and professional in a fast-paced environment.

* Positive, outgoing attitude with a strong sense of teamwork, initiative, and accountability.

* Reliable attendance and punctuality.

* General knowledge of, or genuine interest in, food systems, agriculture, and farmers markets.

* Ability to work early mornings and extended shifts (approximately 6:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m each Sunday,  
  rain or shine)

  

**HIGHLY PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bilingual in Spanish or Cantonese

  

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS/DEMANDS**

This position regularly requires:

* Lifting, carrying, loading, and unloading market equipment weighing 50+ lbs., including tables, chairs, canopies, canopy weights, ATM equipment, barricades, cones, A-frames, and signage.

* Setting up and dismantling market infrastructure and customer service areas.

* Handling garbage, compost, and recycling throughout the market day.

* Walking, standing, bending, twisting, and sitting for extended periods.

* Maintaining clean, safe, and sanitary conditions in a busy outdoor environment.

  

**ABOUT** **AIM**

The Agricultural Institute of Marin is an educational 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization headquartered in San Rafael, California. AIM’s mission is to educate, inspire, and connect communities, farmers, and producers in order to create a healthy, Earth-friendly, equitable local and regional food and agricultural system envision a responsible food and farming system that is environmentally beneficial, economically viable, and socially just. AIM runs Certified Farmers Markets in Hayward, Newark, Oakland, Point Reyes, San Rafael, and San Francisco, serving more than 400 farmers, food makers, and artisans from 40 California counties. We also offer hands-on and virtual education programs for thousands of children and adults, run a farm audit program, operate a mobile market for older adults and underserved communities, and provide CalFresh/EBT and Market Match services to build a healthier, more equitable food system across the San Francisco Bay Area.

  

**DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION**

AIM embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

  

**WE ALSO LOOK FOR PEOPLE WHO**

* **Value inclusion:** listen well, treat everyone with respect, use inclusive language, and support fair access for all.

* **Work as a team:** share responsibility, support coworkers, take part in meetings, raise issues early, and keep building their skills.

* **Proactively s****olve problems:** analyze issues, try new approaches, ask for help when needed, and pre-emptively suggest improvements.

* **Communicate well:** listen actively, adapt their style, stay open, share key information, and resolve conflicts promptly.

* **Put customers first:** act on feedback, respond quickly, stay courteous, keep work areas clean, and recycle properly.

  

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, with priority given to applications received by October 13. The expected start date is October 25 and the position will last through December 20, with the possibility of an extension based on organizational needs.

new_jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic's legal team operates at the frontier of some of the most consequential legal and regulatory questions of our time — from landmark copyright matters to first-of-their-kind AI regulatory frameworks emerging across dozens of jurisdictions simultaneously. As we scale, the volume and complexity of our discovery and information governance obligations are growing rapidly.

We are looking for a Discovery Technical Operations Specialist to join our Litigation and Regulatory team and help build out Anthropic's discovery operations from the ground up, support active matters, and help drive information governance maturation. This is a unique opportunity to be a part of a critical function at one of the most closely watched companies in the world. You will work hand-in-hand with our discovery leads, litigation and regulatory counsel, outside counsel, discovery vendors, and cross-functional partners such as Security and IT to manage retention, preservation, collection, and production of electronically stored information (ESI) across active matters. Beyond matter-level support and programmatic development of discovery systems and processes, you will also help execute the development of Anthropic's broader information governance program, including data classification standards and defensible disposal practices that keep pace with a rapidly scaling AI company's evolving data landscape.

The right person for this role will be equal parts technical operator and operational project manager.

* Improve and support the operational layer of Anthropic's information governance program: retention schedule execution, classification rollout, defensible disposition workflows, and data-inventory maintenance in close partnership with the Discovery Lead and information governance stakeholders

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Patient Experience
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============

Verily Health is a data platform and technology company purpose-built to power AI-enabled precision health solutions that accelerate research and improve care for individuals and communities. Uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, data science, and healthcare, Verily transforms multimodal health data into insights, models, and actions that make healthcare more personalized, predictive, and precise.

**Description**
===============

At Verily, we're building products that help people understand and take control of their health. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to define the engagement and interaction model of our mobile and web app — spanning care, consumer, and research experiences — and reimagine it as an AI-first experience. This role sits at the intersection of systems thinking, emerging AI interaction patterns, and behavioral design: you'll determine where and how AI should be woven into the app to make it smarter, more personal, and more engaging, and you'll build the habit loops and notifications that keep people coming back and meeting program goals.

**Responsibilities**
====================

  

* Define and drive the product vision for making the app "AI-first" — identifying where AI should replace, augment, or reorganize existing flows to create innovative, delightful, integrated experiences rather than being bolted on as a standalone feature.
* Design and experiment with engagement loops, notification strategies, and gamification mechanics grounded in behavioral science, tailored to health contexts where motivation and trust both matter, with success measured by both user engagement and for health outcomes.
* Lead products through the full lifecycle — from discovery and prototyping to launch and iteration — with a bias for action in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.
* Continuously scan and synthesize the latest AI interaction patterns (conversational UI, agentic workflows, proactive/ambient assistance, generative UI, multimodal input) and translate them into concrete opportunities for the app.
* Balance innovation with the realities of a regulated, clinical environment — working with UX, engineering, clinical, legal, regulatory, and privacy partners to ensure new AI and engagement patterns are safe, accurate, and appropriate for health contexts.

**Qualifications**
==================

  

Minimum Qualifications

  

* 4+ years of product management experience building consumer-facing products, ideally in health or health-adjacent fields.
* Demonstrated fluency with current AI product patterns (LLM-based assistants, agentic experiences, generative UI, personalization/recommendation systems) and a track record of applying them to real products.
* Experience designing and measuring engagement or retention mechanics (habit loops, gamification, personalization, nudges) in a consumer app.
* Strong systems thinking — able to zoom out to architecture-level decisions and zoom in to interaction-level details.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action in a space where best practices are still emerging.

Preferred Qualifications

  

* Experience with both mobile and web app
* Direct experience designing or shipping AI-native features (chat/agent interfaces, AI-generated summaries or insights, adaptive/personalized experiences).
* Background in behavioral science, game design, or habit-formation product design.
* Familiarity with healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7) and privacy/security regulations (e.g., HIPAA).
* Experience presenting product vision and architecture decisions to executive stakeholders.

Qualified applicants must not require employer sponsored work authorization now or in the future for employment in the United States.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $140,500 - $210,500 + bonus + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

*Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus or benefits.*

new_jobs.description:
Responsible for ensuring quality and compliance of activities related to the construction, building and commissioning on customer site, from site mobilization, through civil, erection and commissioning work. This includes maintaining and verifying implementation of the site quality plan to ensure that contractual, legal, and internal requirements are met. Schedules and Conduct site audits based on contractual requirements and customer needs. Works with site contractors to ensure job tasks are understood and performed according to local and city / state requirements. Works with Site Manager to ensure work is completed as scheduled with appropriate checks and documentation supported. Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of working project team. Guided by professional practices and policies that are shaped by the role. The Site Quality lead coordinates and reports on site quality activities and on the related quality interfaces, maintaining communications and alignment with client, project team, subcontractors, quality engineer, and site manager on quality-related issues and scope of work. The role has moderate autonomy, requiring high levels of operational judgment.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead all site quality activities and ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, and company quality requirements.
* Develop, implement, and maintain Site Quality Plans and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).
* Review work procedures and method statements to ensure alignment with project specifications and good work practices.
* Coordinate and participate in site inspections, testing, audits, and monthly quality reviews.
* Serve as the primary site quality interface with customers, subcontractors, suppliers, and internal project teams.
* Manage non-conformances, deviations, snag lists, corrective actions, and quality follow-up activities.
* Verify incoming materials and equipment meet approved submittals and project specifications, including proper handling and storage.
* Ensure quality records, inspection reports, turnover documentation, and closeout packages are complete and compliant.
* Support lessons learned, continuous improvement, and site quality awareness through communication and training.
* Partner with site leadership to stop work when safety or quality issues impact compliance or project execution.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quality Management, or a related technical discipline; Electrical Engineering preferred. Equivalent field leadership experience will also be considered.
* 5+ years of experience in site quality, site management, commissioning, construction, or project execution in utility, substation, HV, EPC, or industrial environments.
* Experience developing and implementing Site Quality Plans and Inspection & Test Plans for high-voltage or turnkey projects.
* Strong background in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, and Quality Management Systems.
* Experience leading quality activities in the field and working directly with customers, subcontractors, and suppliers.
* Working knowledge of electrical construction, commissioning, substation installation, or related infrastructure projects.
* Strong understanding of safety, EHS, and lockout/tagout (LOTO) requirements on customer sites.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, document control systems, NCR management tools, SAP, or similar systems.
* Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to travel up to 90% across North America.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in EPC project quality leadership.
* Background supporting substation upgrades, expansions, or new-build projects.
* Internal or second-party audit experience; ISO 9001 audit knowledge preferred.
* Relevant field credentials such as OSHA 30, Journeyman, Master Electrician, or similar certifications.
* PMP certification or strong site/project management experience is a plus.
  

  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong communicator and influence with customer-facing confidence.
* Proven leadership and contractor coordination skills in fast-paced field environments.
* Strong problem-solving, organization, and follow-through.
* Hands-on mindset with the ability to balance quality, schedule, and site execution priorities.
  

  

**The weekly pay for this position is 2,500 USD.** The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. This position is also eligible for a % performance bonus/variable incentive compensation/equity.

  

* The Company pays a geographic differential of 110%, 120% or 130% of salary in certain areas.

Retirement benefits include the GE Retirement Savings Plan, a tax-advantaged 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching contributions and company retirement contributions, as well as access to Fidelity resources and planning consultants.
