new_jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Remote; New York City

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Department**
--------------

Education & Training

  

**About EliseAI**

At EliseAI, we're improving the industries that matter most: housing and healthcare. Everyone needs a place to live and access to quality healthcare, yet both are often harder to secure than they should be.
  
  
By integrating AI agents deeply into existing workflows, we make them more efficient, reduce costs, and improve the experience for everyone.

* **Housing**: We simplify how renters tour apartments, sign leases, submit maintenance requests, and stay connected with their property team—bringing everything they need for their home into one place.

* **Healthcare**: We make it easy to schedule appointments, complete intake forms, and we help patients communicate with providers, so everyone can focus on health instead of paperwork.

With EliseAI, organizations reduce manual work, improve accessibility, and deliver a seamless experience across essential services. We recently raised a $250 million Series E round led by Andreessen Horowitz to accelerate this mission.

**About the Role**

EliseAI is looking for a Field Enablement Specialist to own the in-person adoption experience for our customers as they roll out AI across their properties. You'll work closely with the Director of Operations and the customer education team, acting as both trainer and trusted consultant: diagnosing how a customer's business actually works, then building and delivering the live programs that turn new users into product experts.

This isn't a script-and-deliver role. You'll co-build the AI-powered training tools and customer-specific learning modules you use in the field, and you'll be the feedback loop between what customers need and what our training, customer success, and product teams build next. You’ll be embedded at the forefront of AI, redesigning workflows with the latest advances in agentic AI.

**What you’ll own**

* Adoption in the field: Design and deliver tailored, interactive live training sessions and workshops that give new and existing customers a deep, working understanding of our products.
* Consult, don’t just train: Get close to each customer's workflows and onsite operations, and customize every workshop to their specific needs rather than running a one-size-fits-all deck
* Co-building the toolkit: Partner with the customer education team to develop AI-powered training tools and customer-specific modules that make every future session sharper
* Closing the feedback loop: Drive our product forward by bringing back actionable feedback from the field
* Iterating in real time: Proactively seek feedback throughout each training, spotting gaps and adjusting your approach on the spot
* Work cross-functionally: collaborate with teams across the company to make sure customer training evolves in line with our product, our business, and our customers
* Stay ahead of the field: track industry trends and best practices in training and onboarding, and bring new approaches back to the team
* Represent EliseAI: help attract top-tier talent to join the team
* Travel: up to 75% of the time. This is a field role; the best work happens onsite with the customer

**Who fits**

You come from training, customer experience, consulting, or property operations background, and want to drive adoption and innovation forward across our most critical industries.

* The natural teacher: you can make a technical product click for a skeptical property manager quickly, and turn them into a champion
* The consultant instinct: you diagnose how a team actually works before you open the deck, and you customize on the fly when the room needs something different
* The builder: you want to shape the training tools and modules you use, not just run someone else's script
* The road warrior: packed travel calendars energize you, not drain you

**Requirements**

* Ability to conduct sessions in both English and Spanish fluently
* 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing training, coaching, implementation, or consultant role. Experience in the multifamily industry as a trainer, coach, or onsite team member is a plus
* Experience translating customer education resources into live, interactive training for diverse audiences
* Willingness to travel up to 75% of the time to conduct in-person training sessions with clients
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly
* Technical proficiency, with the ability to quickly learn and demonstrate expertise in our products
* Proven ability to build rapport with customers and establish trusted advisor relationships.
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

**Job Compensation Range**

The salary range for this role is $70,000-115,000. EliseAI offers a competitive total rewards package which includes base salary, equity, and a comprehensive benefits & perks package. Exact compensation is determined based on a number of factors including experience, skill level, location and qualifications which are assessed during the interview process. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided by our Recruiting Team during the hiring process.

EliseAI provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
  
  
Employment with EliseAI is on an “at-will” basis, meaning that either the employee or the company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

Overview:

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Program Manager to lead cross-team, multi-vendor coordination that keeps the VA's patient-generated health data (PGHD) ecosystem running reliably, supporting the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Connected Care. This role oversees delivery across the VA's PGHD applications, Validic's aggregation platform, and emerging integrations such as Google Health, spanning technical alignment, stakeholder management, cross-team orchestration, and data-quality oversight. The Program Manager enables national-scale delivery of device-derived health data to VA clinicians and Veterans, aligning program goals, stakeholder needs, and technical execution to mission-critical outcomes. Strong candidates bring program management and Agile delivery experience, plus the ability to navigate complex enterprise healthcare systems.

This is a fully remote (United States) position and may require up to 10% travel for quarterly reviews.

Responsibilities:

The Program Manager coordinates delivery across multiple products, vendors, and teams in a matrixed environment, supervising staff who may or may not be supporting the work this position functionally oversees. This role aligns efforts across engineering, integration partners, and system owners; manages schedules and status reporting; resolves issues to meet productivity, quality, and client-satisfaction goals; and monitors progress across the portfolio, stepping in to solve problems with team members and stakeholders. Generally reports to a Senior Program Manager or Portfolio Lead.

* Supervise staff in a matrixed environment, including performance oversight, coaching, hiring, and professional development, recognizing that direct reports may or may not support the work this position functionally oversees
* Lead cross-functional coordination between VA teams, Validic, and third-party device vendors, aligning priorities, managing issue remediation, and communicating progress across CGM (Abbott, Dexcom), nutrition and sleep data pathways, and new device integrations
* Drive the Google Health API transition across the VA's PGHD applications and pipelines, managing discrepancy tracking, SQA testing follow-ups, OAuth/CASA approval workflows, and vendor inquiry resolution to keep step, energy-burned, resting heart rate, and sleep metrics accurate as legacy device APIs sunset
* Coordinate investigation and resolution of data-quality issues across multiple sources (for example, duplicate CGM records, dropped components in sequential updates, conflicting event ID updates, and observation-volume drops following SDK changes), synthesizing findings for pipeline teams and Validic engineering
* Facilitate vendor partnerships and support negotiations for new integrations, driving expansion efforts such as new CGM and activity-data pathways and the API and org-settings updates they require
* Manage pre-read and action-item workflows to ensure productive, well-prepared coordination sessions, producing pre-read materials, organizing agendas, and maintaining cross-team action logs across CGM, device mapping, pipeline fixes, and API transitions
* Oversee alignment across PGHD applications, mobile and web teams, and downstream pipelines, ensuring synchronized release planning, remediation of SQA-identified issues, correct application of device-definition rules, and consistent handling of edge cases
* Manage integrated program plans, including risk and status reporting
* Resolve cross-team blockers and escalate risks to leadership as needed
* Provide oversight of sprint planning, execution, and retrospectives across teams, ensuring they are carried out effectively and meet delivery goals
* Serve as a central liaison across VA digital health programs, collaborating with PGHD governance groups, clinical SMEs, OIT, pipeline engineering, and product teams to maintain unified progress toward national PGHD goals
* Manage vendor and integration partner deliverables, ensuring quality standards are met
* Advise clients on strategic and technical solution options

Qualifications:

**Required Skills and experience**

* Bachelors degree with 12+ years experience (or commensurate experience)
* Experience supporting federal programs or within the VA/OCC environment
* Familiarity with health data integration platforms such as Validic, or with CGM/remote patient monitoring data (for example, Abbott, Dexcom)
* Experience with health data API transitions or integrations such as Google Health or similar device APIs
* Experience with native mobile (iOS and Android) and web product delivery
* Background working with patient-generated health data (PGHD) or clinical data sources
* Knowledge of compliance standards, OAuth/CASA workflows, or healthcare-related systems
* Familiarity with modern tech stacks, APIs, cloud platforms, or DevSecOps
* Experience with backlog tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar
* Experience working with distributed, remote teams

**Clearance required:** Ability to obtain and maintain a Suitability/Public Trust clearance.

Posted Salary Range: USD $150,000.00 - USD $160,000.00 /Yr.

As a Specialized Assessment Product Risk Program Manager (SA PRPM), you will be a critical driver in Meta’s risk management and product integrity efforts. You’ll operate with a high degree of independence—bringing a broad perspective to problems, exercising independent judgment, and contributing to team-level goals for cross-functional risk review. The ideal person will have exceptional judgment and the ability to work across a range of variable, often ambiguous risk factors.This is a senior individual-contributor role.
